chapters.title: Chapter 1151: Plans To Grow Stronger
paragraphs: Jest remained seated for a couple more minutes, going through the battles he fought with Seraphina, making sure every move he made and how it was countered by the opponent was scrutinized.
He made sure he learned everything there was to know about Seraphina. After all, his path is all about copying his opponents and making what he learned better.
In other words, he can learn any skill or technique through observation, but in the end, he will transform what he had copied into something way more fancier and better.
After reviewing everything, he decided to take his original plan and go fight more swordsmen.
As someone who is walking a completely different path, he can only find ways to advance his path on his own. There is no preplanned path for him to merely follow.
So he chose to return to society and see if he could find some swordsmen to challenge.
Before coming to the Immortal World, he had challenged many swordsmen in the lower realm, and through the many battles he fought, he was able to create a solid foundation for his own sword path.
Now, it seems he must get back to such to that life again.
This time, however, he will be facing Sword Emperors and above in what is promised to be the biggest challenge of his life yet.
"It will be fun," he said with a smile before taking a few items from his space ring.
"That lady wouldn’t just let me go scot-free, so I’d better disguise myself before appearing back in society."
Jest’s intelligence is on a whole different level.
He had already seen what people are capable of before coming to the Immortal World. This means he had already made plans to change his appearance in case things happened as they did.
Now, with a dye and a few other items, within an hour, he turned into a redhead with an above-average handsome appearance.
He also swapped his sword, taking it out with a black leather sheath. He changed into a pair of grey leather robes and was soon on his way.
His destination doesn’t matter. For now, he wants to level up his swordsmanship, so he left the cave and started chasing his dreams.

’In a way, that crazy lady helped me see a hint of the next path I should take. If she were slightly normal, I would have searched for her and thanked her.’ Jest smiled, recalling how many times he came close to dying at Seraphina’s sword.
The thought of thanking her was wiped from his mind the next second, causing Jest to smile.
A week later, he returned to Shengdao City.
This time, he knew not to keep his sword in hand, since the last time it had nearly resulted in his death. He walked down the street, listening in on several conversations while he planned his path.
After roaming for a while, he decided to grab a bite and gather information since people love to talk mostly in restaurants (inns).
As expected, the moment he entered, he saw dozens of people eating. The majority of them were talking, showing they were comfortable where they were.
Jest had done this many times, so he looked for a table closer to the window and sat down. He was served, and so he started eating while keeping a close ear to what everyone was saying.
He managed to gather some information that would help him.
It turned out in Shengdao City, aside from there being an abundance of swordsmen, there were also many hunter teams that a person could join and frequent a place called Devil’s Maw.
According to what he gathered, the Devil’s Maw is like a land for demon beasts. It is extremely dangerous, but also a place for cultivators to gather materials and sell to grow their cultivation.
Jest found out that to get there, one needs to be in a team. Naturally, some talkatives even made him understand that to join a team, having the strength of an Empyrean is required.
Of course, since swordsmen are regarded as powerful, a Sword King with a good enough reputation can easily find a team to join.
Jest weighed his options and soon realized this wasn’t something he wanted. Of course, there will be battles against other humans, since when it comes to human greed, no one knows how deep it goes.
But even if he gets to battle humans, there is no telling that they will be the best of the best. So he started waiting for more suggestions.
Since people were talking, he was bound to hear something interesting.
Soon, a conversation between two youngsters caught his attention.
"I learned the Whispering Wind Sword Sect will be taking in new disciples a year from now," one of them asked the other.
"I heard the same thing, too. How long has it been since they accepted new disciples again...?"
"3000 years ago, if my memory serves me right."
The two nodded, taking a sip of their wine.
"I suppose being the top-ranked sect in this star system gives them the authority to go thousands of years without accepting new disciples."
"True. Although their rivals, the Azure Blade Sword Sect, had accepted new disciples 100 years ago, I hear they too will be opening their gate for new disciples 10 years from today."

"Good thing I still have my token from the last time. I guess I will wait another 10 years before joining them. After all, getting an invitation to take part in the Whispering Wind Sword Sect is nearly impossible for ordinary folks like us."
"Indeed. And who are they kidding setting such cheating method to disgrace the poor and less privilage...Tch"
The look in the two youngsters’ eyes said they wanted to join one of these two sects; however, their background isn’t the best.
They have no powerful backing.
Of course, joining a top-ranked sect like the Whispering Wind Sword Sect would be an honor; however, they knew it would not be easy.
Such a sect would have only geniuses, so despite their genius, they didn’t seem too enthusiastic.
"I mean, trying our luck isn’t too bad. Who knows, maybe we might just pass and become disciples there. I know I would be happy if I entered the same sect as heirs of powerful immortal families."
His friend also smiled. "I suppose you are right. I, too, would love to join such a sect."
Jest nodded to himself, knowing that if this sect was the topmost-ranked sect, then joining them would give him an endless number of geniuses to fight with.
’Naturally, that will speed things up for me since I would just have to challenge them and experience their sword realm for as long as I could.’
Jest beamed with happiness.
This was a perfect path forward for him.
However, before joining such a place, he needed to have some presence in this city. After all, he later did some research and found out that having a reputation would help him in the long run.
So Jest chose to go to the Devil’s Maw alone and started working to clear the demon beasts. Killing demon beasts is something that keeps the planets safe, so there is a ranking and rewards.
The ranking is called the Demon Hunter Chart. There is a team chart and a solo chart. Since Jest went there as an individual, he was registered in the Solo Demon Hunter Chart.
He used the name Genesis, so when he started hunting, the points added up to his name, Genesis.
He planned to get into the top 100,000, since that is considered good enough to give him some standing in society.
Jest had only a couple of months to make this happen, so he entered the wild just like he did back in the Sword Valley. Jest faced many dangers then, and now he started facing more.
Beasts of all shapes and sizes kept coming for his life, but as someone who had already been through such danger, he didn’t panic and only started his massacre.
Soon, weeks passed, but Jest continued killing demon beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1152: Ranking Up
paragraphs: "Shit!"
Jest exclaimed, jumping back.
Just when he jumped away, a 300-meter-long centipede burst out of the ground and raised its head into the air, standing 120 meters tall.
Jest landed on a large stone 300 meters away and appraised the demon beast.
"This one is a Peak Root Immortal." Jest’s gaze swept along the thick and segmented carapace of the centipede, and he took in a deep breath.
Its body is covered in a thick and metallic carapace, making it nearly impenetrable. It also had this metallic shine to it that only seemed to discourage anyone who saw it.
It was the kind of metal that told people their sword or spear was not getting through this monstrosity.
Jest knew he had met a dangerous one.

It had already been seven months since he ventured into the Devil’s Maw. In the past months, he had stayed in the outer section of the forest, where only beasts ranging from Spirit Lord to Empyrean lived.
Of course, one would say that in Immortal Worlds, such beasts are bugs that would be stomped on. However, to Jest, who was only at the Heavenly Ascension stage, they were a danger to him.
Naturally, he struggled a bit against them until his cultivation finally advanced to the Empyrean stage.
That was when things picked up for him.
He became so powerful due to his solid foundation, allowing him to go against even Life and Death stage demon beasts and a few humans without fear.
It took him just four months for his name to appear on the Demon Hunter Solo Chart. That meant he was among the top 100,000 demon hunters.
Though not too impressive, it was to be noted that his name appeared within a pool of immortal hunters. It was something to be proud of.
But that was just the start for Jest.
Soon, however, he started rising through the ranks like a firework. By then, Jest had entered the deeper outer region, where he started facing Empyrean, Life Stage, and Death Stage beasts.
Safe to say, he was having a field day with the beasts.
He had been to the deepest and darkest depths of the Sword Valley, and so he knew what danger was and how to live with it.
By the time he spent seven months in the Devil’s Maw, his name had risen to the top 50,000. That was when people began to notice him.

But Jest still had four months to spend in the Devil’s Maw before leaving to see if he could get into the sect that the one person he planned to ignore for the rest of his life was actually the leader of.
He, of course, didn’t know that.
He had no idea that the Seraphina lady who came close to killing him several times was actually the sword emotion of the leader of that sect.
But since he never got the chance to know her, he would be walking into the maw of the abyss, where the Devil’s Maw would look like a playground.
Jest took a deep breath again and then eyed the centipede for a moment before taking out a talisman.
"Good thing I made dozens of these before entering the Inner Region." The moment he activated the talisman, a sword appeared in the air and took a powerful swing.
The swing manifested Seraphina’s sword realm, which had been transformed into a sword arc, cleaving into the Root Immortal centipede demon beast.
It may have had a hard carapace, but using a sword realm as a sword technique possessed so much power that even it couldn’t tank it.

Its body slammed hard into the ground, raising both dust and stones into the air. After everything had settled, Jest took out a jade tablet from his space ring, pointed it at the beast, and channeled his energy into it.
A beam of light shot from the jade tablet and enveloped the beast. After scanning it for a few seconds, the body vanished, and Jest looked at the writing that appeared on the jade tablet.
"Hmm, looks like I need to kill five more Root Immortal beasts to finally enter the top 25,000." A smile appeared on his lips as he looked at his current rank.
This time, he had done something unprecedented.
Killing an Immortal as a mortal warranted some applause. Of course, he merely used a talisman which he had created for moments like these.
If the beast had been less than 100 meters tall, he would have fought it. But with such a colossal body, a single miscalculation would have resulted in his getting injured or worse — dying.
Thankfully, one of the many things he learned before coming to the Immortal World was how to compress his sword skills into a talisman, thereby unleashing them with a mere channel of energy.
It is taxing to create, but with dozens in hand, he will be having a field day for as long as he only meets Root Immortal beasts and below.
Jest ventured deeper into the forest, hunting all he could find.
In no time, three months passed, and so, Jest decided to leave. However, by then, he had risen to the top 20,000 and amassed millions in Immortal Stones.
After traveling for three days nonstop, he finally arrived at the checkpoint where he would claim his rewards before leaving.
Every beast had a point and a price. The points helped him rank up, and the price was what he would now claim. Hunters don’t come there to mess around.
"Good to see you didn’t die young man," an old man with a white beard said, looking at Jest. Months back, when Jest came to register to become a solo hunter, he had tried his best to stop him.
Naturally, Jest, with his Heavenly Ascension stage cultivation, had no business entering the Devil’s Maw. So he tried to persuade him not to throw his life away.
But Jest didn’t take his advice, and so he only sighed and registered him. Now, it seemed he was surprised to see him.
Jest smiled and handed the jade tablet to him. "Told you I would return alive, old man."
The old man brushed his beard and smiled with a nod. "I guess you did."
He pressed the jade tablet against a jade crystal, checking to see how much would be given to Jest. A formation appeared on the tablet, and he then placed the jade tablet in it.
A purple light illuminated the jade crystal.
The old man widened his eyes when the purple light appeared.
"Impossible!"
Jest shook his head and smiled weakly. "Nothing is impossible, old man."
"I don’t understand. How can a mortal enter the top 20,000 ranks? That is impossible."
The old man looked at Jest, then turned to the jade crystal. ’There is no way this is faulty.’
Out of curiosity, he checked the amount Jest had amassed, and to his shock, it was in the millions.
One Immortal stone was worth ten million high-grade Spirit Stones. Jest had amassed millions of them from the hundreds, perhaps thousands, of beasts he had killed.
"I happen to be in a hurry, old man, so if you will please hurry for me."
The old man snapped out of his daze. "Sorry, young man, I will get right on that."
Jest nodded and started waiting for the old man to process his money. Some time later, he was handed a space ring filled with millions of Immortal Stones. Then he was handed a new jade tablet.
This one is purple, showing he had reached the top 20,000, earning the rank of a Demon Hunter King.
He bid the old man farewell and left.
Soon, he was back in Shengdao City, where he did some shopping before leaving for the disciple selection exams at the Whispering Wind Sect...
Meanwhile, news of a mortal appearing in the top 20,000 Solo Demon Hunter Chart started to spread.

chapters.title: Chapter 1153: Infinity Stairway
paragraphs: Amid the rumours and chaos about a mortal appearing in the top 20,000 Solo Demon Hunter chart, Jest travelled several miles to reach Mongo City, where the Whispering Wind Sword Sect is located.
He quickly asked for directions to the sect.
Thankfully, he didn’t suffer to locate the road leading to the sect, which is situated atop a mountain. A large and extremely tall stairway leads to it.
Jest stood tall at the bottom, looking at the thousands of people slowly climbing up. They were all here for the same reason he came, so he could only sigh.
However, learning that this place is a no-fly zone, he couldn’t help but feel a little dispirited. He rushed to Mongo City, so he was tired. Now, he would be forced to climb this tower of a stairway.
"No-fly zone, huh?" Jest chuckled.
"I’d better start early. Who knows what other surprises await me up there?" Jest took the first step and started climbing.
In no time, he had ascended a hundred steps and continued climbing.
After 3 hours, with no destination in sight, Jest began to see the hidden nature of these stairs...

"Come to think of it, the man who gave me the directions didn’t tell me how long this stairway is. He only said, ’Go that way and climb the stairway. It will shortly lead you to where you want to go.’"

Jest scratched his head. "Was he speaking hypothetically, or did he mean it when he said it will shortly lead me to the sect? I mean, it has been hours already, and in my book, that is more than a short time."
Just looking back, he could only see people climbing after him. Forward too, thousands were climbing.
"I cannot stop just yet." He continued to climb, passing a few people on the way.
Soon, a week passed, and Jest had climbed thousands of stairs.
"That is the 100,206th step. Just what the hell is going on here?" Jest paused, looking down to see many people lying exhausted on the steps.
He looked up and saw a similar scene. However, he also saw a determined few who continued to climb. This scene also energized him.
"I didn’t escape slavery to give up just like that."
With this focused mindset, he continued to climb. Soon, he didn’t even realise the spiritual energy in the air had vanished.
Three weeks later, he finally saw a large gate in the distance. The sight he had been hoping for had finally appeared within his view, but with how exhausted he was, Jest couldn’t relish it.
Nevertheless, he kept going. Seven hours later, he finally saw the gate well. It was made from the bones of immortal beasts, hard enough to withstand even the full-on assault of an Immortal Lord.
Naturally, Jest didn’t focus on the gate too much.
His gaze turned to the hundreds of carriages packed on one side of the gate, and to the hundreds of neatly dressed young people standing and some sitting in them.

Jest didn’t want to think about it, but seeing this sight, a memory from when he was a slave was triggered. Back then, the slave masters would bring the privileged and rich heirs to the slave mines just to come and mess with the poor slaves.
Jest himself had been a victim multiple times.
Perhaps it was due to all those tortures that he finally decided to embrace death and scale the Wall of Doom, finally attaining his freedom.
They would pack their carriages just as they did here, do what they came to do, and then leave.

Jest turned and looked behind him, but he saw nobody coming from behind him. It had been three weeks and millions of stairways. Naturally, they also lost access to their spiritual qi along the way, so it was pure physical strength.
Seeing none within his sight, it meant they had given up.
He sighed, and then after an hour, he started climbing again. In no time, he appeared on level ground, earning the stares of many.
"No way he actually climbed the Infinity Stairway," someone exclaimed, causing more to narrow their eyes at Jest, who had dropped to his knees and was panting for breath.
"He clearly climbed the Infinity Stairway. But just how was he able to do it? Nobody has ever succeeded in climbing it for the past three hundred thousand years."
"I know, right? The last person to climb it had already ascended to a god world. This is impossible."
More voices entered the conversation, prompting some of the youngsters in the carriages to frown.
They clearly saw Jest come from the Infinity Stairway, a measure put in place to allow those who aren’t privileged enough to secure a spot as new disciples to gain entry into the sect.
So far as you can climb, you will automatically become a disciple. Many tried and failed...
"They said halfway through the climb, all spiritual energy is cut off, allowing only physical strength to climb the rest. Just how did this skinny kid manage it?"
Jest slowly caught his breath and then stood up, allowing his pride to bloom as he turned and looked at the many eyes on him.
After observing them for a while, a scoff escaped his lips. He then started walking in a certain direction to sit down and recover.
Suddenly, a chuckle came from a certain carriage.
Jest turned and looked at the person who chuckled.
"So what if he climbed the Infinity Stairway? In the end, it is we who have solid backing that will become powerful immortals and rule this universe as if it were our own.
Or you think forming immortal qi is something just anybody with no wealth can do," He sneered and added a few words that he shouldn’t have.
"It would be best if you found a master and pledged your useless life to them. I don’t mind putting a collar around your neck and making you my dog."

Dozens laughed, feeling nothing wrong with what the young heir said. To them, having a slave was normal, and so if Jest became a slave of an heir from one of the powerful immortal families, his future would be bright.
After all, gaining entry to the sect and having powerful backing are two different things.
Unbeknownst to him, the person he said this to hates only one thing in this life, and that is slavery. Hearing these words triggered him, but Jest was a patient predator.
He turned to the bastard who spoke and, in a chilling tone that caused many to shudder in their boots, he made a promise.
"The only reason your head is still attached to your body is because you have a powerful backing, and killing you would be bad.

However, once we both become disciples, I will have the sect as my backer, which means I will have the backbone to kill you. As they say, as long as you are inside the sect, nobody can touch you from the outside."

He smiled and moved closer to the bastard. "I will kill you, and there is nothing your father or mother can do about it. So be happy with the few moments you have left, for your death is looming over your head.
This is my promise to you."
With that, he turned away and left, leaving the poor bastard to break into a cold sweat.
What Jest didn’t know was that, just now, when he got angry, the sword realm he learned from Seraphina manifested, or at least a sliver of it did.
And since it was the sword realm of a sword immortal, the pressure was several times more lethal.
Inside an immortal cave somewhere in the core region, the green-haired lady opened her green eyes and looked toward the entrance of the sect.
"Impossible...Just how..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1154: Becoming a Disciple
paragraphs: The old man and woman entered the immortal cave again, having been summoned.
The last time they saw the sect leader was a year ago, so getting summoned this early was a shock to them.
Mostly, they can go 1,000 years without seeing or hearing from her. However, in just a year, they got to meet her twice, all because of a mortal.
"Sect leader, is everything alright?"
The old man asked.

He and the old woman are the acting sect leader and vice leader while the main sect leader is away. In fact, for much of the sect’s history, many disciples came and went without knowing the true sect leader.
She is walking a path that requires her to cultivate ten emotions simultaneously. That is not something that can be achieved while she is focusing elsewhere. So she is always in seclusion.
"Is today the sect disciple selection trial?" she asked.
The old man and woman nodded. "Yes, sect leader. We managed to pick 450 potential disciples after our people personally handed the invitations to them after seeing what they can do."
The old lady took over. "However, it seems we have another genius among us this time around. A young man climbed the Infinity Stairway in under a month."
The image of the redhead she saw a few seconds ago came to her mind.
Just now, when Jest coldly spoke to the arrogant bastard who provoked him, the sword realm that the Seraphina lady uses manifested in Jest.
Perhaps he didn’t even notice, but as the owner of this sword realm, she did, and that shocked the hell out of her.
Sword realms are unique. Two people cannot have the same sword realm. This means a person cannot cultivate another person’s sword realm.
So there was just no way Jest could manifest the ’Arrogance Sword Dao Realm.’ But he did, and she saw and sensed it.
There was no mistaking it.
She cultivates the Ten Emotion Sword Dao Realm, so she knows when one part of her sword realm is used by someone else.
"The young man who climbed the Stairway, do you know his background?" the green-haired lady asked.
The old man and woman shook their heads.
"I see. Since he climbed, he has automatically become a disciple. Accept him and offer him the chance to see if he can pass the Sword Bridge.
If he can pass three levels, take him to the Purple garden and let him stay there."

The old man and woman looked at each other, clearly taken aback by the sect leader’s decision. The Sword Bridge is a heavenly item that every disciple strives to have a chance to use once in their lifetime.
In the sect’s history, only a handful of disciples have used it. In fact, many core disciples never had that chance, and they probably never will.
So, giving a Sword King who has no background, and even a mere outer disciple, a chance to use it is like making him the target of everyone’s attacks.
Everybody will hate him regardless of how talented he is.
Also, the acting sect leader and vice clearly hate the idea of allowing an outer disciple who had no merit to use the sword bridge... something powerhouses send their children to try their lock with.
"But sect leader, isn’t this a little too sudden? We know nothing about this kid, and for some reason, I feel like he has disguised his appearance.
Of course, I am not sure of that, but for someone who can’t even show their real face, giving the sect’s most prized treasure to him is not something many will like."
"I don’t care how you or anyone feels... Just send the kid to the Sword Bridge... That is an order."
The old man nodded. "I am sorry for questioning the leader’s command. I will accept my punishment."
"Just do as I say and get the kid into the Sword Bridge." They nodded and left.
The green-haired lady looked at Jest, who was seated and cultivating to recover his energy before the trial began.

Although he may have played tough just now, the truth was that his entire body was aching. Climbing millions of steps within a month is not something a mortal should be able to do. However, Jest did, and now, all he could do was recover.
Thankfully, his recovery was coming along much faster. In no time, he had recovered about 80% of his strength and was slowly moving toward complete recovery.
Meanwhile, murmurs continued to spread among potential disciples.
"That was chilling. Even though he didn’t direct his threat to me, I felt his threat in my gut, and I know for a fact this bastard is cooked."
"He definitely is cooked. Just look at him, still in shock even after minutes had passed."
The young man, who had tried to use his status as the heir to an immortal family to disrespect Jest, still looked pale, his expression devoid of life as he stared at Jest in a daze.
He is an heir of a powerful immortal family. He had met many immortals, but none had made him feel fear until Jest came. Now, nobody can tell what is going on in his head.
However, they know one thing: if he gets into the sect, Jest would indeed have a legal reason to kill him, and that is as simple as challenging him to a death match.
He can, of course, decline his challenge, but that will only prolong his eventual death.
"If I were him, I would just leave and not set foot here ever again."
"That is indeed a sound plan. However, knowing the trouble our families go through and the pain we had to endure just to secure a spot in this trial, I am sure he wouldn’t leave.
He is a Sword Emperor and a Life Stage cultivator after all; maybe he still has the belief that he can escape certain death."
"Hahahaha." One thing about the immortal families—they always look for each other’s downfall, so whenever they get the chance to ridicule each other, they don’t slack off.
Suddenly, the large door opened, and two old people, a man and a woman, walked out. Everyone sitting inside a carriage jumped down and put away the carriages.
Many recognized the two elders as the sect leader and vice leader of the Whispering Wind Sect.
Jest, who had recovered, had to stop and also stood up.
’Immortal Lords, huh... But why are they looking at me with indignation?’ Jest sensed their stares, and for some reason, he felt like they didn’t like him.
’I am overthinking it. Maybe they recognized my greatness and want to leave an impression.’ After convincing himself, Jest smiled in his head.
The old man was the first to speak. "My name is Immortal Lord Ritsu, the acting sect leader of the Whispering Wind Sword Sect." He turned to the old lady.
"And this is Immortal Willa, the vice sect leader."
"Welcome, everyone."
Everyone, potential disciples, bowed.
Jest remained standing like a tree.
This didn’t escape Immortal Lord Ritsu and Willa’s gaze. However, they said nothing.
"We only came here today to welcome you, since after today, some of you will become part of this family. Nevertheless, be happy you at least had a chance."
After saying that, Immortal Ritsu turned to Jest. "What is your name, boy?"
"Jest."
"Pardon me," he said.
"My name is Jest, old man."
Many disciples gasped, hearing how Jest addressed the old man. However, to their shock, Immortal Ritsu smiled. "Bold name for a brat."
"I get that a lot, but I guess all credit goes to my mom, who had a sense of humor."
"That, I guess, she had. In any case, we are here for you."
"Lucky me, I guess."
"You climbed the Infinity Stairway, so automatically, you are a disciple. However, because of your remarkable feat, you now have a chance to challenge the Sword Bridge. Do you accept?"
Jest first turned toward the immortal heir whom he had promised to kill and made the throat-slitting gesture, causing the poor kid to break into a cold sweat.
Immortal Ritsu and Willa narrowed their eyes, seeing this, and sighed.
’This kid is interesting,’ they both thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1155: Jest’s Name
paragraphs: Immortal Ritsu and Willa led Jest into the gate under the gaze of every potential disciple.
Many were jealous of him, not because he got to get in faster than they did, but because he managed to climb the Infinity Stairway that is famous for remaining unconquered for years now.
Words hadn’t reached the disciples in the sect yet, so for now, the haters and those who would try to prove something would come and try their luck as if it were some game.
But before that, those who saw themselves as high and mighty were now pissed. The rude and arrogant heirs of the prestigious immortal families were pissed.
They would smear Jest’s name, ridicule him, and even go as far as to tarnish his reputation and defame him.

However, Jest had been a slave before, and like the Sword Dao said, he was still a slave at heart. So someone like that, who had experienced the harshest life out there, most certainly wouldn’t mind a few jests here and there.
Perhaps due to the life ahead of him, his mom gave him a name for it.
"Jest... That is an unusual name," Immortal Lord Willa said, giving Jest a sidelong glance.
Jest smiled. "Imagine my shock when, on one of my many adventures in the lower realm—oh, did I mention I came from the lower realm? Well, I did, and it is an amazing place in case you are wondering.
Now back to my story...

...Imagine my shock one day when I happened to chance upon a secret archive of a long-dead immortal. I do not know his name, but he seemed to be obsessed with a certain dragon said to have ruled the primordial era.
At first, I only saw him as a joke. However, after perusing through the many scrolls I found, I was inclined to believe it.
That dragon was a menace, and I, for one, would love to stay far away from him." Jest smiled, causing the two immortal lords to look at him wryly.
"How does this have anything to do with you being called Jest?"
Jest chuckled, looking at the dull look on Immortal Lord Ritsu’s face.
"Picture a terrifying dragon who rules an entire era, but his name is Chaos. I mean, that doesn’t sound like someone who should have been allowed to rule an entire generation, right?
Chaos.
I mean, he can just wake up one day and say, ’Let there be chaos,’ and everything will go haywire.
The point is, a name is important, but it’s also a silly thing we often use to gauge how amusing we are. My name is Jest, a rather unserious name for a handsome person like me.
Somewhere far away, there can be an extremely handsome and rich young lord who likes to sit by the beach and read, but his name will be SGTCWBY.
At the end of the day, it is whether or not we actually take our name and make it memorable."

Jest chuckled. "Sometimes, we even end up with completely different names simply because of how amazing we are. So if a name like Chaos once ruled an era, then perhaps a Jest can also become something, someone more than a joke."
"SGTCWBY, what kind of name is that?" Immortal Lord Willa asked, genuinely intrigued and slightly disturbed. Her best takeaway from all Jest said was the unpronounceable name.
She couldn’t pronounce it well.
Jest smiled weakly and said, "Maybe it is an acronym."
"What is an acronym?"
"I have no idea." Jest looked up and saw a large, beautiful gate 300 meters away. He turned and looked at Immortal Lord Ritsu.
Knowing what he wanted to ask, the man sighed and answered, "The gate behind us is part of a formation that protects the sect from danger.
The real gate is the one in front of us. It acts as a teleportation gate and an entrance into the sect."
"Oh, that is thoughtful. How quaint."
Jest examined the gate and looked at a 400-meter-tall, 200-meter-wide high-quality jade stone used as a door.
He only smiled inwardly and wondered just what else these immortals considered waste.
This amount of jade could handle the cultivation of millions of people for millions of years in the lower realm. Here, it was being used as a gate.
A few minutes later, they walked through it and entered the sect’s inner region immediately. It was, as expected, beautiful in every shape and size.
They practically appeared at the center of the inner sect, drawing many eyes. Walking with the acting sect leader and the vice surely warranted some much-needed attention.
Jest didn’t mind.
His mental strength was too firm to be bothered by this many judgmental stares.
’Potential targets to help me rise in the path to sword supremacy.’ Jest smiled in his head, knowing his intentions for joining the sect were anything but pure.
After walking for a few minutes, they arrived at a pagoda with 14 floors...
"This is the Sword Bridge..." Immortal Lord Ritsu began, but Jest cut him off.
"Excuse me, but I don’t see any bridge... Shouldn’t calling it Sword Pagoda be a catchier name?"
Immortal Lord Ritsu gave Jest the ’you think I don’t know that’ look.
Jest smiled and focused on the pagoda. Knowing the Immortal Lord was this close to snapping his head off, he shifted his focus to the reason they were here.
"So, like I was saying before I was rudely interrupted, this is the Sword Bridge, and as you can see, it has 14 floors, which we refer to as levels.

Each level has a unique swordsman or woman you must defeat using everything you can do with the sword. Know that you cannot use anything outside swordsmanship. This means only sword techniques and nothing else.
You will face a Sword King at the first level. If you manage to defeat that level, you will face Sword Emperors for levels 2, 3, and 4.
If you manage to pass level 2, you will become an inner disciple. If you can pass the 5th level, which is a Sword Divine, you will become a core disciple.

If, for some reason, I can’t believe I’m saying this... but if you manage to defeat level 8, you have a chance to comprehend the Great Arcana Sword Tablet, a treasure that every Sword Immortal gets to comprehend at least once in their life."
"How about level 14?" Jest asked with a small smile, causing Immortal Lord Ritsu’s mouth to twitch...
However, he answered, "Maybe focus on surviving a Sword King first before thinking about a Sword God."
Immortal Lord Willa smiled on the side and added, "Know that the moment you step onto the Sword Bridge, every last disciple will be able to watch you.
So, better take things seriously, because if you become the first disciple to fail at level 1, it will haunt you for the rest of your life."
Jest nodded and turned to Immortal Lord Ritsu. "Say I manage to become an inner disciple, can I challenge someone to a death match?"
Immortal Lord Ritsu had already seen the interaction between Jest and the heir at the sect entrance, so he knew for a fact that the two could not live under the same roof.
Jest clearly despised the poor heir.
’Maybe I should just fail the poor boy before this brat creates a problem for himself. That is Immortal Lord Taz’s son. If he dies, this bastard will never know peace even in here.’
"Focus on becoming a disciple first."
Some time later, Jest entered the pagoda. In the entire sect, projections appeared showing Jest challenging the Sword Bridge.
Even on the outside, the potential disciple gets to witness this challenge,

Many were jealous of him, not because he got to get in faster than they did, but because he managed to climb the Infinity Stairway that is famous for remaining unconquered for years now.
Words hadn’t reached the disciples in the sect yet, so for now, the haters and those who would try to prove something would come and try their luck as if it were some game.
But before that, those who saw themselves as high and mighty were now pissed.
The rude and arrogant heirs of the prestigious immortal families were pissed.
They would smear Jest’s name, ridicule him, and even go as far as to tarnish his reputation and defame him.
However, Jest had been a slave before, and like the Sword Dao said, he was still a slave at heart.
So someone like that, who had experienced the harshest life out there, most certainly wouldn’t mind a few jests here and there.
Perhaps due to the life ahead of him, his mom gave him a name for it.
"Jest...
That is an unusual name," Immortal Lord Willa said, giving Jest a sidelong glance.
Jest smiled.

Well, I did, and it is an amazing place in case you are wondering.
Now back to my story...
...Imagine my shock one day when I happened to chance upon a secret archive of a long-dead immortal.
I do not know his name, but he seemed to be obsessed with a certain dragon said to have ruled the primordial era.
At first, I only saw him as a joke.
However, after perusing through the many scrolls I found, I was inclined to believe it.

"How does this have anything to do with you being called Jest?"
Jest chuckled, looking at the dull look on Immortal Lord Ritsu’s face.
"Picture a terrifying dragon who rules an entire era, but his name is Chaos.
I mean, that doesn’t sound like someone who should have been allowed to rule an entire generation, right?
Chaos.
I mean, he can just wake up one day and say, ’Let there be chaos,’ and everything will go haywire.
The point is, a name is important, but it’s also a silly thing we often use to gauge how amusing we are.
My name is Jest, a rather unserious name for a handsome person like me.
Somewhere far away, there can be an extremely handsome and rich young lord who likes to sit by the beach and read, but his name will be SGTCWBY.
At the end of the day, it is whether or not we actually take our name and make it memorable."

The real gate is the one in front of us.
It acts as a teleportation gate and an entrance into the sect."
"Oh, that is thoughtful.
How quaint."

This amount of jade could handle the cultivation of millions of people for millions of years in the lower realm.
Here, it was being used as a gate.

chapters.title: Chapter 1156: Jest’s Wager
paragraphs: Every disciple, regardless of where they are and what they are doing, had to drop everything and focus on the unannounced Sword Bridge challenge.
"Who is that kid?" a core disciple asked, sheathing his sword since he was in the middle of practice when the Sword Bridge projections appeared.
"He is an outsider."
"How did you know?"
"Look at his clothes. Those aren’t something a disciple of this sect would have." The disciple who said these words was clad in a grey robe, a privilege reserved for core disciples.
Jest’s brown leather robe is in no way the official wear of the sect. Not even the outer region disciples will wear something like that.
"Then why would the sect allow an outsider to challenge the Sword Bridge?" This question left many disciples and even sect elders puzzled.

There was no way an outsider was allowed to challenge the Sword Bridge, said to hold so many secrets. All core disciples lust to have a few minutes’ chance to challenge it, but the requirements to get on the slot are rather hard.
It also takes time to activate it.
But a mere outsider is allowed access.
One can already see their hatred for Jest building up.

However, while everyone had their own opinions, Jest appeared in a valley and began walking. There was a mountain on both sides. Trees lined the mountain peaks, giving the whole environment a calming look.
Jest suddenly came to a halt when he sensed someone walking from a cave. The person stopped 100 meters from him.
"So another one has come, huh?"
A burly man holding a large broadsword spoke, causing the air around him to twist and turn.
’A Sword King with level 9 Heavenly Sword Energy, huh?’ Jest smiled, sensing the powerful intent and aura of the sword emanating from the man.
"I suppose you are the one I have to defeat to pass this level."
"But of course. However, the last person who came was a Sword Emperor, and he spent five hours before getting past me.
Also, over the millions of years I’ve spent guarding the entrance to the Heavenly Sword Bridge, only one person managed to kill me.
You... unfortunately lack all the qualities to defeat me. So do yourself a favour and surrender before things become embarrassing for you."
Everyone could hear the conversation happening between Jest and the burly man. This left them all in a daze.
Nobody had ever had this much conversation with the sword guards, so this was a first.
Jest smiled and gave the burly man a calm appraisal. "You wanna make a wager?"
The burly man, for some reason, was inclined to listen to what Jest had to say, so he thought for a moment and nodded.
"Speak."
"I wager that I will be able to defeat you in under five minutes and in less than fifty moves using close combat." The burly man raised his brow, hearing what Jest said.
On the outside, everyone gasped.
"This kid is arrogant." Everyone nodded in agreement, hearing what Jest had just said. The angry ones even started cursing the arrogant bastard who thought he was better than everyone.
Moments like this, if Jest were around, he would say something along the lines of, ’But I am indeed better than you.’
Unfortunately, he is inside the Sword Bridge...
"You sound confident, kid."
"Just because my name is Jest doesn’t mean I am unserious." Jest smiled and winked at the burly man. "So what do you say, wanna hear the price for winning or failing?"
"Go ahead."
"Well, if I manage to defeat you, which I believe I can easily do, you will have to have a serious duel with me where you will utilise your sword realm to its full potential.
If then you manage to kill me, that is it, but if I win, you will keep fighting with me till I am satisfied."
"You have yourself a deal." The burly man was the type who loved to fight, so this offer was right up his alley. "However, if you lose, you cannot challenge the Sword Bridge for one million years."
"Deal."
Many watching this shook their heads.

"What an idiot. He had a chance, and instead of making good use of it, he wasted it." A core disciple grit his teeth and clenched his fist. "I will personally kill him for wasting this precious opportunity."
Many disciples had already put Jest at the top of their kill list.

To them, Jest, who is a mere Sword King, shouldn’t even have had the chance to challenge the sword bridge. But since he had the chance and now wasted it on a wager they all believe he will lose, the least they can do is kill him to wipe their anger and frustration.
Inside the Sword Bridge realm, Jest stood calm with a smile on his face.
The burly man smiled and said a couple of words that made Jest frown. "Since we are going to fight, perhaps showing your true face will be worthwhile."
’He saw through my disguise, huh?’
Jest smiled, knowing there was no point hiding behind a mask anymore. He retrieved something from his space ring and swallowed it.
In an instant, his hair turned black, and his above-average looks changed, showing his true handsome face.
This reveal caught many off guard. However, they didn’t even stop to think that the brat they’d been looking for, a while back, was the one standing before them.
Jest smiled weakly and spoke. "There you go, mister. Now, how about you give me a name to your handsome face? It would be rude to keep calling you mister."
The man smiled and answered, "You can call me Adrian."
"Well then, Adrian, how about we start?" The sword in Jest’s hand changed, replaced by a new one, sheathed in a brown sword sheath.
Immortal Lord Ritsu and Willa widened their eyes when they saw this.
"It is him," he muttered.
Jest pulled out his sword, and the sheath vanished into thin air. He looked at Adrian, who stared at his sword and smiled.
"You know, there are 1.6 million sword moves in existence. I happen to know all, so I would love to see how you will get past me, Adrian."
Saying that, he just moved, and in under a second, he was before Adrian.
Jest stabbed his sword at Adrian’s chest, but the burly man blocked it with the thick blade of his colossal greatsword.
The impact sent vibration running through Jest’s hand. However, he moved to his left the next second and struck with his sword.
Adrian again blocked; however, just as their swords met, Jest let go of his hilt, allowing the sword to spin and move over the colossal greatsword.

His other hand caught it and unleashed an upper swing that gave Jest little time to raise his sword to meet this quick attack, so he used his left hand to block, only for Jest to repeat the same sleek move.
Adrian found his defense dismantled from just that one move. On the outside, the true swordsmen saw what Jest did, causing all of them to widen their eyes.
The level of timing that went into executing this move was unprecedented. Just a slight miscalculation and everything would be over for Jest.
However, he casually used it twice, and now Adrian had completely lost all sense of how Jest would move next.
This move was something Jest created for when he faced someone more physically fit than him.
"Much easier than expected."
Jest muttered and then sidestepped to his left and unleashed a vertical swing that mid-strike changed into a horizontal swing.
It cut across Adrian’s torso, but because of the metal armor he had on, he wasn’t bleeding. However, that one cut said it all.
Jest glided across the ground using his sword as a pivot, spinning his body like a ninja. A second later, his sword was pressed against Adrian’s neck.
"You lost."
Everyone held their jaws like they had lost their minds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1157: Shocking Everyone
paragraphs: It took less than ten moves for Jest to defeat Adrian.
That is a little too much for anyone, much less a Sword King, to achieve.
Jest promised to defeat Adrian in under five minutes using fewer than fifty moves. In the end, however, he did that in under a minute using fewer than ten moves.
This left everyone in shock.
"What did I just watch?" a disciple asked, feeling his mind turning off.
He just could not wrap his mind around the fact that Jest defeated Adrian in under a minute. "This is impossible. Nobody has ever passed the first level of the Sword Bridge in under a minute before."
Many nodded.
However, inasmuch as they would love to deny it, Jest had done it, and judging by the look on Adrian’s face, everyone knew there was no underhanded technique used by Jest.
Adrian looked at Jest calmly, then spoke. "You read my moves like an open book."

Jest smiled calmly. "But of course. I already warned you that I have mastered all 1.6 million sword moves a person could make. Even if there were thousands of you, as long as your sword moves are within the 1.6 million moves I know, then defeating you is possible."
Adrian shook his head and smiled. "I guess you aren’t arrogant for nothing."
"I like to prove my words, making sure everything I say is backed by evidence. Just now, I have proven to everyone why I am the most qualified to challenge the Sword Bridge."
Naturally, that was a subtle jab at the disciples, seething with anger on the outside. Those who caught his words gritted their teeth, but they could not deny that perhaps his words were indeed true.
"So what now?" Adrian asked, and Jest pointed his sword at him.
"Now, the best part." His sword aura burst out. "You fight me using your sword realm."
Adrian smiled and activated his sword realm. In an instant, Jest found himself somewhere else. The moment Adrian unleashed his sword realm, the scene changed.
The scenery around Jest twisted and shattered like broken glass. In the blink of an eye, the tranquil valley was gone.
Now, he stood on a vast battlefield under a crimson sky. Blades jutted from the ground like gravestones, and a cold wind howled across the endless plain.
There were many broken swords that slowly rose into the air just when Jest appeared in this sword realm.
Clicking sounds filled the air, almost as if many battles were being fought inside this realm.
"Powerful."
"It is my Broken Sword Realm. In here, the chances of your sword breaking are very high, so be sure to have a spare one just in case." Adrian said with a mocking smile.
He said nothing else again, but instead focused on the battle that was about to be fought.
Jest moved, and Adrian also did, the broken swords following him.
They clashed, and this time, Jest sensed Adrian was no easy person. However, with his plans now in motion, he could only endure.
In no time, he began seeing things that would help him achieve his goals much faster. The clash seemed to intensify from there onwards.
"This is unbelievable. He is not even using his sword realm, yet he is going toe to toe with this person," a disciple said, feeling his reasoning not making sense anymore.
In the path of swordsmanship, one knows that to fight a sword realm, one needs to also use one’s own sword realm. Sword realms have unique laws that work in favor of the owner.
A swordsman can make it so that when inside their sword realm, their reaction speed multiplies, making them much faster, thereby making their opponent slower.

In such a situation, the right move for the opponent is to use their own sword realm. However, Jest was not using a sword realm, yet he was keeping up with Adrian, and as the battle intensified, people began to see that he was even gaining the upper hand.
Adrian, too, can see that, but he said nothing. To him, this is a peak battle where he is meeting someone with a true understanding of the sword.
The Broken Sword Realm made Adrian’s sword sturdier and his movements faster, all the while keeping him surrounded by broken swords, allowing him to launch projectiles as he pleased.

"Common sense is not a real thing. There is no way he is fighting without a sword realm." Even the core disciples who had already become Sword Divines and Legends couldn’t help but be taken aback by Jest’s display.
As the hours went by, Jest slowly began to see a much broader nature to Adrian’s sword realm.
Five hours later, Jest’s breakthrough came. He defended against a projectile fired by Adrian, then, instead of relenting, he sat down and closed his eyes...
The next second, he gained his second enlightenment since arriving in the Immortal World.
Yet again, people let their jaws hang open as they witnessed what had happened.
"He has gained enlightenment."
"No way he actually gained enlightenment."
"Are you blind? He has gained enlightenment, and from the look of things, he seems to have been working toward this from the start."
"You are saying his plan all along was to fight against a sword realm without using his own sword realm. Just what was he hoping to achieve?"
"Isn’t it simple? He was aiming for this very moment. Maybe he had found a way to fight against the sword realms.
So, like creating one’s own technique, he went ahead and started developing a way to do it. Now, the Heavenly Dao has recognized his effort and granted him enlightenment.
He will be coming out much stronger and more dangerous."

As swordsmen, they all seemed to be impressed by what Jest had done. He not only defeated Adrian in less than ten moves, but he had treated their duel like a lesson, which had now granted him access to enlightenment.
"Interesting," Adrian, who also realized what had happened, smiled and walked back. At this point, nobody knew whether he was a real person.
However, judging by his behavior now, many were inclined to believe he was.
Of course, he cannot die, so there is also that contradiction. But for now, he has a name, and his behavior screams that he is a real person.
Three days later, Jest opened his eyes.
Powerful waves of sword energy exploded out of his body, causing Adrian to stand up and look at Jest in shock...
"This energy... It is my sword realm."
Adrian recognized the fluctuation immediately...
Jest looked at him and smiled. Then he raised his sword and harnessed Adrian’s sword realm, which had become a sword skill for him but, innately, also a sword realm.
He turned in a certain direction and took a big swing.
Instead of a sword arc shooting out, countless broken swords appeared in the air and rained down on the mountain, digging a big hole into it...
Adrian widened his eyes.
"No way... That is Adrian’s sword realm. Did he just copy Adrian’s sword realm into a technique?"
"That is impossible. Sword realms are unique; there is no way a person can comprehend another’s sword realm down to their energy fluctuation."
"Well, he did, and looking at the expression on the man’s face, he clearly didn’t expect that."
"Damn."
Inside the Immortal Cave, the green-haired sect leader widened her eyes, seeing what Jest had accomplished...
"What path is this kid walking, and just how can he copy others’ sword realms?"
She muttered, feeling her mind spinning.
"He is dangerous." A vicious light flashed across her eyes as she looked at the kid who made her go down on her knees and beg just over a year ago.

Nobody has ever passed the first level of the Sword Bridge in under a minute before."
Many nodded.
However, inasmuch as they would love to deny it, Jest had done it, and judging by the look on Adrian’s face, everyone knew there was no underhanded technique used by Jest.
Adrian looked at Jest calmly, then spoke.
"You read my moves like an open book."
Jest smiled calmly.
"But of course.
I already warned you that I have mastered all 1.6 million sword moves a person could make.
Even if there were thousands of you, as long as your sword moves are within the 1.6 million moves I know, then defeating you is possible."
Adrian shook his head and smiled.
"I guess you aren’t arrogant for nothing."
"I like to prove my words, making sure everything I say is backed by evidence.
Just now, I have proven to everyone why I am the most qualified to challenge the Sword Bridge."
Naturally, that was a subtle jab at the disciples, seething with anger on the outside.
Those who caught his words gritted their teeth, but they could not deny that perhaps his words were indeed true.
"So what now?" Adrian asked, and Jest pointed his sword at him.
"Now, the best part." His sword aura burst out.
"You fight me using your sword realm."
Adrian smiled and activated his sword realm.
In an instant, Jest found himself somewhere else.
The moment Adrian unleashed his sword realm, the scene changed.
The scenery around Jest twisted and shattered like broken glass.
In the blink of an eye, the tranquil valley was gone.
Now, he stood on a vast battlefield under a crimson sky.
Blades jutted from the ground like gravestones, and a cold wind howled across the endless plain.
There were many broken swords that slowly rose into the air just when Jest appeared in this sword realm.
Clicking sounds filled the air, almost as if many battles were being fought inside this realm.
"Powerful."
"It is my Broken Sword Realm.
In here, the chances of your sword breaking are very high, so be sure to have a spare one just in case." Adrian said with a mocking smile.
He said nothing else again, but instead focused on the battle that was about to be fought.
Jest moved, and Adrian also did, the broken swords following him.
They clashed, and this time, Jest sensed Adrian was no easy person.
However, with his plans now in motion, he could only endure.
In no time, he began seeing things that would help him achieve his goals much faster.
The clash seemed to intensify from there onwards.
"This is unbelievable.
He is not even using his sword realm, yet he is going toe to toe with this person," a disciple said, feeling his reasoning not making sense anymore.
In the path of swordsmanship, one knows that to fight a sword realm, one needs to also use one’s own sword realm.
Sword realms have unique laws that work in favor of the owner.
A swordsman can make it so that when inside their sword realm, their reaction speed multiplies, making them much faster, thereby making their opponent slower.
In such a situation, the right move for the opponent is to use their own sword realm.
However, Jest was not using a sword realm, yet he was keeping up with Adrian, and as the battle intensified, people began to see that he was even gaining the upper hand.
Adrian, too, can see that, but he said nothing.
To him, this is a peak battle where he is meeting someone with a true understanding of the sword.
The Broken Sword Realm made Adrian’s sword sturdier and his movements faster, all the while keeping him surrounded by broken swords, allowing him to launch projectiles as he pleased.
"Common sense is not a real thing.
There is no way he is fighting without a sword realm." Even the core disciples who had already become Sword Divines and Legends couldn’t help but be taken aback by Jest’s display.
As the hours went by, Jest slowly began to see a much broader nature to Adrian’s sword realm.
Five hours later, Jest’s breakthrough came.
He defended against a projectile fired by Adrian, then, instead of relenting, he sat down and closed his eyes...
The next second, he gained his second enlightenment since arriving in the Immortal World.
Yet again, people let their jaws hang open as they witnessed what had happened.
"He has gained enlightenment."
"No way he actually gained enlightenment."
"Are you blind?
He has gained enlightenment, and from the look of things, he seems to have been working toward this from the start."
"You are saying his plan all along was to fight against a sword realm without using his own sword realm.
Just what was he hoping to achieve?"
"Isn’t it simple?
He was aiming for this very moment.
Maybe he had found a way to fight against the sword realms.
So, like creating one’s own technique, he went ahead and started developing a way to do it.
Now, the Heavenly Dao has recognized his effort and granted him enlightenment.
He will be coming out much stronger and more dangerous."
As swordsmen, they all seemed to be impressed by what Jest had done.
He not only defeated Adrian in less than ten moves, but he had treated their duel like a lesson, which had now granted him access to enlightenment.
"Interesting," Adrian, who also realized what had happened, smiled and walked back.
At this point, nobody knew whether he was a real person.
However, judging by his behavior now, many were inclined to believe he was.
Of course, he cannot die, so there is also that contradiction.
But for now, he has a name, and his behavior screams that he is a real person.
Three days later, Jest opened his eyes.
Powerful waves of sword energy exploded out of his body, causing Adrian to stand up and look at Jest in shock...
"This energy...
It is my sword realm."
Adrian recognized the fluctuation immediately...
Jest looked at him and smiled.
Then he raised his sword and harnessed Adrian’s sword realm, which had become a sword skill for him but, innately, also a sword realm.
He turned in a certain direction and took a big swing.
Instead of a sword arc shooting out, countless broken swords appeared in the air and rained down on the mountain, digging a big hole into it...
Adrian widened his eyes.
"No way...
That is Adrian’s sword realm.
Did he just copy Adrian’s sword realm into a technique?"
"That is impossible.
Sword realms are unique; there is no way a person can comprehend another’s sword realm down to their energy fluctuation."
"Well, he did, and looking at the expression on the man’s face, he clearly didn’t expect that."
"Damn."
Inside the Immortal Cave, the green-haired sect leader widened her eyes, seeing what Jest had accomplished...
"What path is this kid walking, and just how can he copy others’ sword realms?"
She muttered, feeling her mind spinning.
"He is dangerous." A vicious light flashed across her eyes as she looked at the kid who made her go down on her knees and beg just over a year ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 1158: Jest’s Dominance
paragraphs: Jest smiled at Adrian and then sheathed his sword and gave him a gentle bow. "Thanks for your cooperation, Adrian."
Adrian didn’t know how to feel about any of this. He had just been tricked into using his sword realm, only to be copied and turned into a sword skill.
That is not something anybody would want.
Sword realms are something special to every swordsman, so copying somebody’s sword realm is akin to becoming them in every aspect.
But while using the sword realm can differ since Jest doesn’t live in Adrian’s head, copying them is still something to be afraid of.
But, Jest not only learned his sword realm, but he even turned it into a sword skill that he can improve on for years to come.
"You know what, nice meeting you too, Jest. One day, when you make it to the god world, maybe we will meet. I would love to have a true sword battle with you."
Jest smiled and nodded.
’So my suspicion is true. He is indeed real.’

A wicked smile appeared on Jest’s face, but Adrian seemed to have seen through him. "You are wondering whether the sword realm I showed is indeed the complete form. But even if it isn’t, this smile on your face says you want to experience the real deal, huh?"
"It is only natural to end what we started."
Adrian smiled and tapped Jest on the shoulder. "You might want to become a Sword God fast, then. I have a feeling we are going to have a much bigger battle one of these days."
Jest nodded. "I can’t wait for that day to come."
Adrian smiled and pointed to the side.
A portal formed. "I am not sure they are going to fall for the same trick, so don’t slack off."
Jest nodded, already aware that the next levels would be difficult. However, thanks to Seraphina and Adrian, he managed to copy the two-sword realm.
Naturally, this also opened his mind to what he had to do next to form his sword realm and become a Sword Emperor.
’I just need 30 minutes with them and their sword realm will be mine,’ he thought as he walked closer to the portal. ’Unless, of course, they choose not to use it.’
He paused and let an evil smile appear on his face. ’But what then are they going to do if I start bombarding them with Sword Realm sword skills?’
With the smile on his face, he appeared in an arena where a beautiful lady, wielding two swords, stood waiting for him.
The moment Jest appeared inside the arena, the lady raised one sword and activated her sword realm. In an instant, thousands of white lights appeared in the air and shot at Jest.
"Oh, right off the bat, I see." He also raised his sword and unleashed Adrian’s sword realm, causing thousands of broken swords to shoot out, colliding with the white lights.
Jest charged forward and engaged in melee with the lady, who didn’t want to give him a chance to even experience her sword realm.
Unbeknownst to her, activating it alone is enough for Jest.
Minutes went by, but neither Jest nor the lady took a break. Their swords kept meeting in fierce attacks.
No swordsman watching this battle could afford to turn away from it.
They all focused on the close combat, while the sword realms continued to clash, too. Of course, since Jest was merely a Sword King without a real sword realm, he was being overpowered.
However, when it came to close combat, he was moving effortlessly, showing the lady he had not only mastered all forms of swordplay, but he had actually created a counter for every last one.
Twenty-five minutes later, Jest smiled and distanced himself from the lady.
"Have you given up?" she asked, pointing one sword at Jest.

The latter smiled and shook his head. "I don’t give up easily, lady. I only moved back to show you this." Jest raised his sword, and under the shocked gaze of everyone, thousands of white lights appeared in the air.
"Impossible..."
The lady took a few steps back, her expression shocked. "Nothing is impossible, lady... Nothing."
Jest winked at her and gestured forward. "Now, show me how you will defend against your own sword realm."
A few seconds later, the lady was defeated.
"Your name is Jest, right?" the lady asked, and Jest nodded.
"I am Sword Saintess Mirily of the Light Sword Temple. Find me when you get to the god world." She took a swing, and a portal opened. "This battle will be continued properly then."
"I look forward to it."
Jest gave her a small bow as thanks for allowing him to experience her sword realm. She gave him a nod of approval, and Jest was off on his way.
The third level took Jest to a mountaintop where a demon man with red skin and two twisted horns sat sharpening a sabre.
"They call me the Red Blood Sabre King. Do well to remember that name before I defeat you."
Jest smiled and sarcastically replied, "My name is Jest, no last name, no middle name."
"Then prepare to face me, Jest."
Jest nodded, then a grin appeared on his face as he side-stepped to his left, evading a powerful vertical swing of the demon’s sabre.
"Clone, huh... Makes me remember the Mirage King. Defeating that bastard took me a while."
Jest had already suspected the demon was a clone, so he prepared for the real copy to appear, and just when he did, the battle began, turning into a fierce and deadly one.

The Red Blood Sabre King’s sword realm was as one would expect. It was a domain of blood and carnage where every sword arc turned into a blood arc. Also, the bloodier the battle, the stronger it grew.
It was the kind of sword realm that required constant slaughter to master.
But an hour later, Jest manifested the domain into one deadly sword slash that formed a dragon head made from red sword aura.
In the end, the demon was defeated...
"Hmm, master was right. There are indeed those who just don’t make sense."
Jest smiled and bowed toward the heavily panting demon. "Thanks, senior."
The demon shooed him away, annoyed that he couldn’t defeat Jest.
The sly Jest smiled and jumped into the portal leading to the fourth level. There, he met another demon, but this one was very handsome and had a sword box containing ten swords.
He placed the sword box vertically on the ground and sat on it in a lotus posture.
"Classic," Jest couldn’t help admiring this display as his gaze landed on the demon.
"You seek to learn my sword realm, huh?" He opened his eyes, causing a potent sword intent to envelop the area.
Jest smiled and nodded. "I am currently stuck on my sword path, so if this senior can enlighten me, I will be eternally grateful."
The demon studied Jest with his jade-like eyes for a few minutes before a smile appeared on his face.

"Very well. Adrian is my junior, so if you managed to get past him, then I suppose you are qualified to challenge the Ten-Star Sword God." The sword box opened on both vertical sides, and five swords came out of each side.
They rose into the air and formed a star shape.
"Magnificent," Jest murmured and then pulled out his sword. "Let’s dance."
Kent opened his eyes, causing a terrifying sword intent to envelop the entire Sword Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 1159: Sword King
paragraphs: Kent remained seated, his expression calm. However, the sword energy enveloping him felt suffocating and extremely dangerous.
Kent had already merged his blood Qi with his sword Qi, forming the undisputed Blood Sword Qi.
Due to this, not only was the energy around him sharp enough to easily shred a Sword Sage, it was also suffocating, filling the air with so much danger.
Kent relaxed, his expression calm as he sat there, unmoving for six months.
Every day that passed, his aura only seemed to grow increasingly suffocating.
In fact, he experienced six complete changes, with each change pushing his sword Qi (aura) and sword intent to a new, terrifying level.

Even Sword Emperors would have to be careful when facing him. It turned out that in what felt like six months of meditation, Kent had experienced 6 major enlightenments that pushed his understanding of the sword to a whole different level.
In the end, after the sixth change, Kent took a deep sigh and opened the tower interface to see what had changed.
The first few messages he saw brought a smile to his face.
⟦You have become a Sword King⟧
⟦You have attained Level 6 Heavenly Sword Energy (Sword Aura and Intent)⟧
⟦Your Genesis Sword Realm has partially awakened⟧
Only three messages, but they carry so much information. He had become a sword King and even partially awakened his sword realm.
These two things are major events he has been working towards.
"I suppose this is only right," Kent smiled. The memories he had unlocked for Jest felt so real, like how Chaos’s memory did when he found out what happened to Elina.
He entered Jest’s life and felt all he felt, allowing him not only to remember but to feel what it was like to be the greatest swordsman to ever live.
He felt it all, and now that he is back to himself, he couldn’t help feeling like he had been reborn as a true swordsman all over again.
"Damn, I was awesome back in the day." Recalling how badass he was when he stepped onto the Sword Bridge, he couldn’t help feeling like there was so much fun to be had soon.

"Sword Bridge, huh?" He turned and looked at the Sword Bridge just a couple of kilometers away from him. Seeing the large sword positioned like a bridge, he smiled. "Now, that is how you create a sword bridge, not a pagoda."

The memory of how he teased Immortal Lord Ritsu about the pagoda made him smile. He didn’t know how bold he was back then. The man he was teasing could easily have killed him, but Jest didn’t seem to care.
He was carefree and lighthearted, something Elina tried to turn Chaos into until her untimely and tragic death.
Jest may have been a slave, but now he was a free man who would do anything to remain free.
Kent then turned to the third message and opened it to read the complete information.
⟦Your ’Sword Genesis Realm’ has partially awakened. To fully awaken it, you must complete the following:⟧
↠ Conquer the 6th level of the Sword Bridge and comprehend their sword realm (Past).
↠ Conquer the 6th level of the Sword Bridge and comprehend their sword realm (Present).
↠ Defeat 10 Sword Kings and comprehend their sword realm.
↠ Defeat 5 Sword Emperors and comprehend their sword realm.
↠ Defeat 2 Sword Divines and comprehend their sword realm.
↠ Defeat 1 Sword Legend and comprehend their sword realm.
Kent scratched the back of his neck as a pale smile appeared on his face.
"Ah, why did I even bother to check?" Something told him where all this was going, and he knew it would be a wild one. However, since he planned to check, now he knew what he must do.
Not that it is going to be easy.

"The first one is easy. I just have to remember more of Jest’s life and see if he can defeat the Sword Divines." Kent had absolute trust in himself as Jest that he would be able to, despite not yet having memories of that.
He was about to face off against the Ten-Star Sword God when the memory key he used expired.
But being in Jest’s body and feeling what he felt, he knew the bastard wasn’t known as the greatest swordsman to ever live for nothing.
"I believe in myself, and I know I can do it."
"As for the others, thanks to Jest and my own efforts, I will get it done one of these days."
Kent then checked to see how many memory keys were left. However, to his shock, all four keys were used up.
This left a small smile on his lips. "It is to be expected. I have been in there for a while, after all."
Kent looked at the many requirements he would have to personally handle and shook his head. "This isn’t even the requirement to become a Sword Emperor."
Kent wanted to sigh again, but he knew sighing too much would make him look weak, so he decided to check the requirements for the Sword Emperor stage.
⟦Requirements to become a Sword Emperor⟧
↠ Defeat the Seven Horn Nightmare Devastating Shark Beast.
↠ Win the Mount Genesis Supreme Sword Competition.
Only two requirements, but Kent knew they would not be easy to handle. First, despite not meeting this beast just yet, he already knew it wouldn’t be an easy battle.
Kent had a nagging feeling he had yet to meet a true challenge. Of course, in a way, he was thrilled about it. However, he knew he must prepare.
As for the second requirement, Kent was looking forward to it. A sword competition doesn’t depend on one’s strength.
It only focuses on sword mastery, so if he wanted to win, then he must prepare well, because his overpowered Blood Cores would not help him.
It would be a pure battle between swordsmen to see who was the best.
"This means I must focus on awakening my sword realm. Although I am Lord Genesis, there are monsters out there, so I cannot slack off."

It was going to be hard for sure, but Kent had already seen the path forward, so he planned to walk it to the end. After all, there was no telling just what was waiting for him in this sword competition.
Since he had no more memory keys for Jest, he decided to make the next best thing: refine the two Blood Life Seals and the two Blood Death Seals in his possession.
This way, not only would he be hard to kill, but his killing intent would also become much more potent. Aside from that, his sword intent would become much more potent as well.
Four seals appeared, and his two blood cores and flame core came to life. He began refining them right away.
’I have three memory keys for the faceless assassin. For now, I will hold on to them. Once I have some free time on my journey to find Elina, I will review them.’
Kent smiled and sent his mind back to refining the four seals.
Months passed, but since it was tower time, he didn’t seem to care. His ladies were out of harm’s way, and his legions were also recovering, so there was no telling just what he had to worry about.
On the outside, people searching for Kent had started dying in strange ways. This caused most to run back to the Immortal World.
Uncle Drew went out to buy ingredients, but as a side quest, whenever he met someone who was searching for Kent, he didn’t hesitate to dispose of them.
Now, everyone was afraid to even look for him. They didn’t want to die unexpectedly and tragically.
Soon, five years passed inside the tower. On this day, the four seals were done being refined, so Kent decided to absorb them.
For precautionary purposes, he first chose to absorb the Blood Life Seals before focusing on the Blood Death Seals.
Something that enhances his killing intent was not something to be taken lightly.
