After an hour, Kent was done looking through the man’s memories.
’Looks like they too were taking orders from others who are the true people linked to the forsaken race, or at least that is what he thought.’ Kent took a deep breath.
’It doesn’t matter.
Chaos had to kill hundreds of worlds before getting his first true intel on the forsaken race’s whereabouts.
I will just follow up and make sure they pay for their crimes.’
"How did things go?" Uncle Drew asked.
He didn’t even lift a single finger in the massacre that had just ended.
It was all Kent who quelled his anger and dispensed justice.
"I got a location, but it is far from this place.
The bastard broke the item he used to communicate with them before he died."
"Very loyal of him." Both Uncle Drew and Kent smiled.
"That he was.
However, that doesn’t mean he saved them.
The least he did was buy them some time."
Uncle Drew nodded, and then he looked around, seeing thousands of dead bodies lying everywhere.
He waved his hand, and three hooded figures appeared, each radiating the power of a Death Stage cultivator.
"You already know what to do." The three nodded and formed hand seals.
In no time, all the bodies were engulfed in green flames.
Soon, not even their bones remained.
Getting burned by hell flames meant they didn’t stand a chance.
In their place, thousands of green runes rose into the air and moved toward the three hooded figures.
After absorbing all the runes, they vanished back to where they came from.
Kent stood by until they were done.
"Looks like you came back full of surprises, Uncle Drew."
The Night Rider Captain smiled.
"It is all thanks to a fateful encounter I had while in the underworld."
"Whatever that encounter was, I want to hear about it once we leave here," Kent said with a smile.
Uncle Drew indeed came back full of surprises.
Uncle Drew merely nodded and then looked at the now clean battlefield.
Kent also nodded to this, and then he looked up.
"You already know what to do, Universe.
Let’s not delay that any longer."
Immediately, Kent said, the spiritual energy in the air began to grow thin.
Uncle Drew felt the change and looked at Kent as if he were some kind of monster.
The process was subtle yet visible from the start.
In no time, the process came to an end, leaving only spiritual qi in the air.
In the end, the universe didn’t turn the world into a lowly, spiritless place.
Instead, it made it a medium world where reaching the Core Formation stage would be nearly impossible.
To Kent, although he didn’t get what he wanted, this, too, could be accepted.
"Let’s go, Uncle Drew.
We are done here."

chapters.title: Chapter 1169: Peace
paragraphs: With the planet suppressed to a mere Medium world with even less spiritual qi, there was nothing left for Kent and Uncle Drew to do.
The portal had closed some time during the massacre.
But Kent didn’t need a portal to go back. He only needed it to come, and now that he had accomplished what he came to do, it was time for him to leave.

They teleported and arrived in Fedora within a second, where cheers and celebrations were underway. They had prevailed in their battle against the Orc alliance, and now, all they could do was celebrate.
With the Orc alliance gone, the cities under their command would have no choice but to submit to the rule of the Foxkin and their allies.
The peace they once had was restored.
Vexthra approached them the moment they arrived. "How did things go over there?" she asked, hugging Kent.
"It went well. It turned out they were following the orders of another race that was taking orders from a forsaken race."
Kent chuckled.
"King Balma and his allies were merely pawns they planned to use to build a forsaken gate into this world, and well, you already know what the forsaken race is capable of."
Vexthra nodded.

As a god, she knew all too well what the forsaken race was capable of. She personally fought some of them when they suddenly invaded a planet she had travelled to many years ago when she was just a demigod.
She was among the few who managed to escape with their lives.
So she knew all too well what the forsaken race was capable of.

"Do you plan on going after them?" she asked, a little worried. Since the world restrictions didn’t work on the forsaken race, there was a chance Kent might walk into an ambush where there might even be immortals, and worse, even gods.
Of course, with her around, Kent could somehow feel safe. However, as she said a while back, when there were multiple gods, she alone wouldn’t be enough.
So she was worried.
Kent kissed her neck and assured her he would not do anything rash.

"Relax, Vex, I have plans on how to handle them. However, for now, I will hold back from invading the forsaken world. There are some things I must know about myself first before reigniting my long-standing feud with them."
Vexthra nodded to that. It was good enough for her since she also planned to work around the clock, preparing for when Kent would go after the forsaken race.
Obviously, it wouldn’t be long since he wants to know more about his life as Chaos.
Kent observed the celebration happening, and all he could do was smile.
After catching up with Vexthra, he walked hand in hand with her to the palace, where King Hkum and the leaders of the Catkins and Tigerkins were.

The leader of the Catkin was a rather handsome man called Joshua. He has a small body, as all Catkins do. Of course, not all Catkins were petite in nature. Kent could see many with voluptuous bodies. It was just that this man was rather small.
As for the leader of the Tigerkin, she was a fierce-looking warrior who, from what Kent could tell, was a lover of all things battle.
The fire burning behind her beautiful blue eyes told him all he needed to know.
"And this is Queenie Opal Paton, leader of the Tigerkin," King Hkum said, gesturing toward the warrior queen.
"Pleasure meeting you, Queen Opal. I am Kent, as King Hkum said," Kent said with a small smile, making sure the queen softened up a bit. She looked like someone who didn’t trust easily.
"Nice to meet you, too, Kent. I have heard a lot about you from King Hkum."
Kent nodded.

He most certainly would not be staying here for long since he had a journey to embark on. "I have already dealt with the Supreme High World, trying to gain control over this planet through the late King Balma.
Now, unless you three decide to start fighting among yourselves, the peace you wanted has been restored.
There is no need to even consider fighting since there is more than enough land for you all to take." All three leaders nodded.
"Also, I have no plans on interfering with your affairs, so as to how you wish to handle the races that sided with the orcs, that will depend on you.
The only thing I would very much love is to come back here years from now and see a thriving world."
There was no telling what they would decide, but he would most certainly love to see this peace continue for as long as their world existed.
The three leaders saw no wrong in what Kent said. They thanked him, and after a few more talks, Kent left, saying his people would handle the follow-up once they made a decision.
Kent planned to concoct a Tier 9 pill and officially become a Pill Sage before leaving on his journey. He needed to know what would be required of him if he wanted to become a Pill King.
He had become a Sword King, but he also needed to make some progress in his Alchemy Path, so for now, he could only handle what he could and hope for the best.

After he left, the three leaders decided to split the five races into a working race. They would become workers who would ensure not only that the world was safe but also serve as cannon fodder in the event of an invasion from the outside.
In most worlds, they had every right to completely wipe out the five races. However, because they had a conscience and didn’t want to become like the late Orc King, they let them live.
In essence, making them cannon fodder was just a way for the three races to put the fear of eternal servitude in them. They would work around the clock because they at least got to keep their lives.
Of course, with the peace they had now, the chances of being attacked were next to none, for Kent had already made plans to keep them safe for the next couple of hundred years.
He could have just taken them into the tower. However, since they were now safe, he chose to let them stay there.
However, not all of them would be staying there. His ladies and legion had made friends, and so they took them to the tower. And since they could go back anytime they wanted, he let them stay there.
The more people there were inside the tower, the better. After all, he planned to build a functional society inside the tower.
⟦You have concocted a Tier 9 Soul Strengthening Pill. Purity: 100%, Pill Ring: Grey⟧
⟦You have fulfilled all the requirements to become a Pill Sage⟧
⟦Congratulations, you are now a Pill Sage⟧
Kent smiled weakly. He had become a Pill Sage, someone meant to concoct Tier 8 and 9 pills.
However, with the knowledge pouring into his mind now, he knew for a fact that Tier 10 and perhaps Tier 11 pills were what he should chase after.
In short, his understanding of alchemy surpassed his rank.
He looked at the next requirement. What he saw brought a smile to his handsome face.
⟦Requirement to become a Pill King⟧
↠ Concoct a Tier 9 pill using Tier 7 pill ingredients

chapters.title: Chapter 1170: Pill King
paragraphs: ⟦You have concocted a Tier 9 Soul Strengthening Pill. Purity: 100%, Pill Ring: Grey⟧
⟦You have fulfilled all the requirements to become a Pill King⟧
⟦Congratulations, you are now a Pill King⟧
Kent smiled, looking at the message. He had finally become a Pill King, something he had been chasing after for a while now.
With only one requirement needed to become a Pill King, he quickly fulfilled it. Now, he could call himself a Pill King.
Of course, he was still too far from the realm of a Pill God, but with how rapidly he was moving now, it was only a matter of time before he was challenging Pill Gods and Pill Supremes.
"Ah, soon, I will be able to kill the current Pill God as my promise to Vexthra."
Kent still hadn’t forgotten what Vexthra wanted.
Back when he arrived in the realm of hatred and resentment, in exchange for a life filled with joy and happiness, Kent made a promise to kill the current God of Alchemy for Vexthra.
Back then, it sounded like a child’s talk, but now, less than five years later, he had already reached the realm where alchemists were recognized as true alchemists.
He hadn’t forgotten his promise. One day, he will indeed kill the Pill God and fulfill the promise he made to Vexthra.
He could now concoct Tier 10 pills, and looking at what he had achieved before even reaching the Pill King stage, there was no telling if he couldn’t even concoct Tier 11 and 12 pills.

"I’d better become a Pill Emperor soon. The faster I reach the rank of a Pill Sovereign, where I can make Tier 15 pills, the better. I, for one, would love to make pills that will make a huge difference in the universe."
He let his achievement sink in for a bit.
Kent then checked the requirement to become a Pill Emperor next...
⟦Requirement to become a Pill Emperor⟧
↠ Concoct a Tier 10 pill with a grey pill ring
↠ Travel to Planet Bynas and hunt down the Nine Flame Demon Lion
"Another planet with unknown origin," Kent sighed.
⟦That is not true, Master. Planet Bynas is just six hours away from Planet Bayla. The Master can even use an instant teleportation gate to get there⟧
"Oh, how convenient," Kent smiled. "It seems I have nothing to worry about."
He had just discovered that somehow, his planet’s teleporter had recorded the planet where the faceless assassin was born.
Kent had yet to know more about his life as the faceless assassin. However, he knew more than enough to know his childhood was very hard.
Naturally, in his memories, that moment passed like a breeze. So now he wants to go there to explore his home planet and see what he missed back then.
⟦The Master indeed has nothing to worry about. Once you get there, reaching that planet is not going to be hard at all⟧

"In that case, I need ingredients to try my hand at a Tier 10 pill. The quicker I get this done, the better." Kent was happy that at least he now had a clear path to completing all the requirements to become a Pill Emperor.
The tower produced the ingredients, and Kent got to work.
Concocting Tier 10 pills was not easy at all. The process demanded a lot, so Kent was now focused on keeping his attention glued to it.
The knowledge was in his mind. The techniques and everything were in his mind, so all he was doing now was practicing. But even with the memories, it wasn’t easy.
Thankfully, Kent was no simple person, so after three failed attempts, he finally made a 100% pure Tier 10 Soul Nourishing Pill that had a grey pill ring.
Naturally, with that done, Kent could now concoct as many Tier 10 pills as he wanted without having to worry about failing as he did with the first three.
"With that done, I can now start my journey." Kent stood up and stretched. "But first, I must catch up with Uncle Drew since he said he has a message for me.
Also, it’s been a long time, so I must spend some time talking to him before I leave. He and the ladies will be busy inside the dungeon for a while, so I’d better get that out of the way."
He also had some stuff to handle, but he could do that later.
He left the Pill Tower and appeared inside the Harem Tower, where his wives were spending time with Princess Arien and her friend.
"Good to see you again, Princess Arien," Kent said, flashing a handsome smile at Princess Arien, the beautiful princess of the Foxkin race.
She also smiled, her seven fluffy fox tails billowing behind her.
Naturally, Foxkins were super beautiful, and this lady was one of the beautiful ones. She is a beauty, and Kent certainly has an eye for beautiful things.
"This is Indie, my friend, and also the princess of the Catkins." Princess Arien, who was clearly captivated by Kent’s beautiful smile, chose to divert attention from herself to her friend.
She, after all, had made her desire to become Kent’s woman known to her family and Kent’s wives, so finally meeting him after many months apart made her both happy and super flustered.
"Nice meeting you, Indie."
"Same."
Indie was one of the voluptuous cats. Although most of her kin were rather petite, she seemed to carry the Alina gene, giving her broad hips and refined buttocks.
Though not on the same level as Alina, she surpassed most of Kent’s women in the ass department. This, of course, was something the Chaos Dragon wouldn’t let slip away.
"Make yourself at home. Whatever you need, the ladies will provide, so don’t be too shy to ask." Indie nodded.
Indie was an assassin, something Kent immediately noticed from the way she moved. Kent knew she would fit in well with Lani and Vari.
Lady Liora would have bonded with her, too, but she wanted to go back to her home planet first.
That was one of the main reasons why Kent came to the Harem Tower before going to see Uncle Drew.
Kent turned to her and asked,
"When do you plan on leaving?"
"As early as possible." She was not planning on staying there for long. At most, a year to handle some things before leaving.
Now that they were in a high world, her true cultivation as a Spirit Lord had been unsealed. So she wanted to handle some stuff before returning to the tower to cultivate.
"Then be ready. I will be going to the Pill Worlds soon, and since you said your planet is just a month away from one of the Pill Worlds, we might as well spend some quality time on the road."
Obviously, the way Kent said "quality time" sounded different to Lady Liora. She was already aware that the bastard had had his eyes on her for a while now.
But then again, she brought herself, so she could only blame herself.
"I will be ready by then."
Kent nodded and soon left for the mountain garden where Uncle Drew was spending time with the three cosmic troublemakers, Yuna and Purity.
When he appeared in the garden, they all jumped into his arms.

chapters.title: Chapter 1171: Catching Up With Uncle Drew
paragraphs: Getting rid of the five troublemakers was rather easy.
Once they were gone, Kent was left with Uncle Drew, who had been waiting for him to handle his stuff. He had been gone for a while, so they needed to catch up.
"I was getting this close to sending them to the underworld," Uncle Drew said, seeing how Kent had handled the three Lolis and the two immortal troublemakers.
Kent smiled. "They always love to have something to do. In other words, giving them work to do will take their attention from you."

"I suppose it is good to see how to get rid of them from now onwards." Since Uncle Drew isn’t going back to the Underworld anytime soon, learning how to get rid of Gaia and her band of troublemakers was something he seemed happy about.
Once that was cleared, Kent started asking more about Uncle Drew’s time in the underworld.
"How is Nyx?"
"Aside from threatening to send underworld demons after you every single day, she is doing great."

Kent smiled, recalling the time he parted ways with Nyx back when he visited hell. He could tell the soon-to-be Underworld Queen had already fallen for him back then. However, he left knowing they would meet one day again.
Now, she had become a demigod and an Underworld Queen. Her influence is supreme in the ninth level of the Underworld.

"Oh, she said she is close to mastering the first four forms of the Nine-Fold Calamity Whip Art, so if you don’t come to her by the time she is done, don’t blame her if she sends demons to come kidnap you."
"Ah, sounds like something she will do. Remembering those crazy eyes she had on me, maybe that was why I ran away when the time came."
Uncle Drew shook his head, a small smile playing on his lips.
Kent took a deep sigh. "The ladies couldn’t get enough of me, huh?"
The Night Rider captain smirked. He most certainly knew how shameless his young master is, so hearing him say this sounded normal to him.
"Tell me about what happened to you when you went to the underworld a second time."
"A lot happened that I don’t even know where to start." Uncle Drew relaxed his mind and arranged his thoughts before beginning.

"So when I got to the underworld the second time, I asked Queen Nyx to send me to a place called Black Castle. It is a place famous for having a powerful banished soul. The weakest banished soul in the outer section back then was a Spirit Emperor.
So you can guess I was way out of my league for requesting to be sent there."
Kent nodded.
Facing Spirit Emperors at only the Core Formation stage is not something ordinary people can do. He himself had suffered to some extent.
Of course, he quickly breezed through it thanks to his nature, which defies all norms.
"Queen Nyx hesitated for a while, but after convincing her that I would be fine, she sent me there. Thankfully, I was able to convince her to send me.
Naturally, that was a good move on my part simply because reaching the Black Castle had changed everything.

It was a dangerous place for sure; however, it also has powerful and wonderful banished souls. The first few months were taxing and extremely dangerous; however, I managed to survive long enough to form a Night Agent.
Once my first Night Agent was formed and at the Spirit King stage, things became much easier for me. I soon formed 14 Night Agents.
Afterwards, it was all about helping them grow stronger and level up much faster since I was bound to remain at the Core Formation stage till you ascend to a high world."
Uncle Drew paused and let his mind fully encompass the point where everything changed for him.
"On one fateful day, just when we ended a battle that drained us completely, a man who, if I didn’t know better, I would say is your brother, appeared from thin air and saved us."
Kent furrowed his brow, hearing what Uncle Drew said.

Seeing his expression, Uncle Drew smiled. "Trust me, either he is your long-lost redhead twin brother or your father, for he is a copy of you. Of course, he said nothing about his name, but I know for a fact he is a Celestial."
Uncle Drew let the words sink in before adding...
"Maybe he was merely disguising himself; however, I know for a fact he was a Celestial and a friendly one."
"Did he say something that suggested he knew me aside from looking like me?"
"He did. He said saving me and my Night Agents was merely doing you a favour. He even called you a snotnose."
The word struck a chord in Kent’s mind. However, upon reflection, he couldn’t bring himself to accept it.
’It can’t truly be him.’
It seemed he had recognised the person, but he was having a hard time coming to terms with it. In the end, he pushed it to the back of his mind.
"What did he help you with?"
"He awakened an attribute all Night Riders have. It is called [Agent of the Night]. It allows all Night Riders to grow endlessly, regardless of where they find themselves.
It was what allowed me to reach the Death stage, and now I’m moving close to the Immortal stage."
"I see. Sounds like you had a blast."
"That I did. However, I still have some stuff to handle. But before that, I must first become an Immortal."
Kent nodded. He was still shaken about the Celestial, but at least with Uncle Drew now back, he was happy. He would go to Nyx once he was reunited with Elina.
Since he knew Nyx was more than safe, he would seek after Elina first, whose fate remains shrouded in mystery.
"Oh, a friend of yours is now staying with Queen Nyx. I saved her from a bunch of Immortals. I, of course, saved her under Queen Nyx’s orders."
"Which of my friends?"
"She is a Plantkin named Zeraphine, I suppose."
Kent’s eyes widened, his aura leaking slightly... "Who was chasing her? How about the others?"
"She said it was a trusted friend who wanted to kill her for her Immortal Qi. She happens to be a rather powerful and bright lady, you see."

Kent wanted to smile, but his anger began to rise. Having his blood cleansing bath seemed to have shortened his temper. So hearing some of his friends he met 370,000 years ago are in danger made him mad.
"As for the others, she said they are well, except of course the BirdMan."
"Kaelith."

"Yes... that is his name. He had been imprisoned by his family and was being guarded by a demigod. I was powerless to save him, and since Queen Nyx cannot leave the Underworld the way I do, she too cannot go to his rescue yet.
So for now, the one named Kaelith is locked in a rather barbaric prison."
BOOM
Kent’s aura exploded, and Uncle Drew was sent flying.
The mountain garden was completely destroyed by the sudden explosion of his aura,
The people in Gaiaville felt a dreadful feeling press down on them.
Many coughed up blood and passed out, while the strong ones gritted their teeth and continued to endure.
Suddenly, Vexthra appeared in the garden and, with a quick jab, she knocked Kent out cold.
Uncle Drew appeared inside the garden the next second, looking pale... "Well, that went well."
Vexthra glared at him but said nothing. She teleported and appeared in the Harem Tower.
Gaia and her sisters appeared in the destroyed garden, smiles playing on their faces... "Looks like we have to rebuild the garden from scratch."
They were more than happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1172: Bloodlust
paragraphs: The side effect of having his first Blood Cleansing had manifested, and if it had not been for Vexthra being a goddess, Kent would have been consumed by rage so intense that by the time he recovered, he would have caused so much damage.
Thankfully, it happened in a space that required no external interference.

Inside the tower, Vexthra could use her abilities without the heavenly laws doing anything to her. Of course, she had to be mindful of how much of her power she used, or she risked destroying the tower.
After she made sure Kent was safe, she came back to confront Uncle Drew.
"No need to frown, goddess. I merely told the young master about the state of some of his friends in the immortal world."
"What about them?" Vexthra was clearly angry, but she also knew it wasn’t Uncle Drew’s fault.
"One of his friends has been imprisoned by his family in a prison where he is tortured every passing second. I managed to save one of them, but the other one has a demigod guarding him.
He was above my pay grade."
Vexthra’s gaze turned cold.
Naturally, that scared Uncle Drew, but he knew he wasn’t in danger...maybe.
"I didn’t tell you because we both know you would have wanted to go save him."
"You’re damn right I would have. Kent cherishes the people close to him, so he most certainly would be affected hearing one of them is in danger."
"I know, goddess, but we both know if you use your powers in an immortal world, there will be a price to pay. That is something the young master cannot allow to happen."
"I don’t care," Vexthra gritted her teeth and narrowed her eyes at Uncle Drew. "Tell me the planet he is on."
Uncle Drew smiled and responded,
"I am sorry, goddess, but I cannot tell you that."
"What do you mean you cannot tell me that? I planned on saving this person, so tell me the location."
Uncle Drew knew Vexthra was acting out of her unstable emotions. Seeing Kent hurt pained her heart, so she wanted to help him in any way she could.
However, doing so would put her life in danger.
Naturally, Kent would also be affected by that when he woke up. So he could not allow her to willingly walk into something that guaranteed she would have to pay dearly for it.
"The young master would not want you to get hurt, so I cannot tell you where this person is. But I can say this: dying is the last thing we have to worry about.
That man in prison has no plans to give up. He looks like someone holding on for as long as he could. He will not die.
I have also put measures in place to look for a way to pass a message to him. So relax for now and wait for the young master to wake up."
Vexthra wanted to reject Uncle Drew’s suggestion, perhaps knock him out, and look through his memories, but Unity appeared beside her and stopped her.
"Uncle Drew is right, big sister. Kent will be hurt and even more angry if something happens to you. So let’s wait for him to wake up."
Vexthra sighed and then nodded.
She looked at the state of the mountain garden and sighed again. Thankfully, Gaia and her sisters were working on a plan to rebuild it, making it even more elegant this time around.
After a few seconds, she and Unity returned to the harem tower.
Kent was still out, but he was out of harm’s way.
They started caring for him.
It would be a while before he woke up, so they would stay by his side until then. Then they would decide what to do next.
[3 months later]
Kent opened his eyes, only for a wave of darkness to explode out of his body. The darkness stretched for a few meters, then moved back and entered his body.
He closed his eyes again as subtle shadows and true darkness started to move out of his body like a mist...
"True Darkness... Since when did Kent become an assassin with a True Darkness?" Vari said, observing the shadowy mist around Kent.
"It is indeed True Darkness, and an even more potent one too," Lani affirmed what Vari said. This only left them puzzled about what they were seeing.
Suddenly, a symbol appeared on his forehead for a few seconds before vanishing. However, when Lady Liora saw this shadow, her expression changed.
She seemed to have recognized it, but her mind didn’t seem to grasp where she had seen it before. She thought long and hard about it, but even after five minutes, nothing seemed to click.
"It seems he has awakened new abilities, and they are those of an assassin."
"Indeed. Judging from his aura, he has already reached five stars. That makes him a Shadow Saint."
In the realm of assassins, the strength and mastery of an assassin are calculated using stars. Star one is called Shadow Novice, Shadow Adept, Shadow Master, and so on.
It is just like with swordsmanship, only that instead of saying Sword King, assassins say Shadow King.
Kent had, in a way, become a Shadow Saint, just two realms below his mastery as a swordsman. Both Lani, Vari, and Lady Liora were Shadow Emperors.
That showed just how much they understood the art of assassination. Now, they seemed to have recognized Kent’s nature as an assassin, and that alone made them happy.
"I know the mark that appeared on Kent’s forehead."
Lady Liora suddenly said, walking toward Kent. She had thought hard about the symbol, and now it seemed she had remembered something.
"What is it?" Looking at the expression on her face, the ladies seemed to sense something significant was afoot.
"I don’t know if you ladies are aware, but before I became an alchemist, I was an assassin, codename Scarlet Angel. I don’t like to blow my own horn, but I was a very good assassin."
Lady Liora smiled. "Actually, my true rank is Shadow Divine."
Vari and Lani looked at Lady Liora with calm gazes. "I suspected that. But what does that have to do with anything?"

"You see, back when I went around using my skill set to help the poor and innocent, a group of assassins that claimed they had their roots buried deep within many worlds, even Celestial worlds, wanted to recruit me.
Initially, I wanted to reject them, but when I witnessed what they could do, I joined them and worked for many years before taking a leave to create my second persona.
This group claimed their founding father was a very dangerous assassin known only by his codename, the Faceless Assassin.

Legend has it that nobody had ever seen his face before, nor do they even know if he is a he or a she. They claim he can take the appearance of anyone he kills and live their life better than they ever did.
I didn’t believe them, of course. However, every member of this assassin group trusted and believed in the Faceless Assassin.
Eventually, I also started to walk their ways."
"Nice story, Liora, but how does that solve the mark that appeared on Kent’s forehead?" Enzi asked, wanting to get to the point.
Liora smiled and gazed at Kent before responding. "Among the midnight shadows, there are those blessed by the Faceless Assassin. These people can change their faces with a mere flick of their hands.
They are called Faceless Agents, and every last one of them has the symbol of a broken dagger on their forehead."
"So are you saying Kent is a Faceless Agent?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1173: Faceless Agent
paragraphs: "But how is that possible?" Lani looks puzzled.
"Sure, we both know when it comes to Kent, everything is possible. We saw how he alone was able to kill beings stronger than he is.
We saw him make the impossible possible. However, the Kent I know had never joined an assassination organization, nor has he lived a life that his wives are not aware of.
In fact, he is only 22 years old, so when did he live the life that made him a Faceless Agent?"
The ladies also seem puzzled. They had just heard something bizarre, but also, in a way, interesting. The only problem, however, is that they don’t believe what Lady Liora said about Kent is true.
But then again, they also saw the broken dagger tattoo, so there is no telling whether he was indeed what Lady Liora described him as.

"I can’t say whether he is part of the Midnight Shadows, but I know the Faceless Agents who can change their appearance have this broken dagger tattoo, and in the Midnight Shadows, they are the best and most dangerous assassins.
My handler was one of them. When I met her, she was a Universal god, but she appeared as an old poison she had killed millions of years ago.
I have seen this broken dagger symbol many times, so I know what I am saying."
There was silence for a few minutes, all the ladies just staring at Kent’s sleeping body.
"Let’s say he is indeed a Faceless Agent, that he had somehow joined a secret organization of assassins that once followed the Faceless Assassin and still does.
What then does it mean for him? I know assassins like to keep to themselves. If Liora hadn’t fought multiple times, I wouldn’t have known she was an assassin. So what does this mean for Kent?
Is his life in danger? Does this mean he will be leaving, or is this all one big misunderstanding?"
Unity clearly doesn’t seem to like the idea that Kent might leave after he wakes up. However, she knew he would because he would try to save his friend, whom Uncle Drew said was in danger.
That would be dangerous, and well, that scares him.
Her question is valid, too. What if the symbol on Kent’s forehead was one giant misunderstanding?
Just when everyone was pondering that, another wave of shadows and true darkness surged from Kent’s body, causing the assassins to widen their eyes.
"That is the aura of a seven-star assassin... He has jumped straight to Shadow King."
All the ladies widened their eyes. They didn’t know what was happening, but the fact that Kent is growing stronger from merely sleeping is something they are seeing for the first time.
Suddenly, the symbol appeared again, but this time, it was different. This changed the expressions on the ladies’ faces.
First, it was a broken dagger; however, now, it seems to have changed. Instead of a broken dagger, it is now two daggers crossed to form an ’X’.
They didn’t have time to argue about that, because the next second Kent opened his eyes, clenching his head from a throbbing headache.
The ladies quickly raised his back off the bed, and Nara slipped behind him and rested his head between her round and firm boobs.
That feeling instantly lowered the headache, allowing Kent to smile a little.
He turned his head to Vexthra first and smiled. "That was not cool, Vex. I never knew you would one day try to kill me."
Vexthra smiled. "Oh please, if I wanted you dead, I would have done that when you tried to hit on me when we first met... FYI, I actually contemplated killing you back then."
Kent could only look at his goddess with a quiet smile.
Vexthra’s sister also laughed, knowing she was telling the truth because she had told them many times about how close she came to snapping Kent’s neck.
She actually got to do it, but instead of killing him, she helped him calm down. The bloodlust he felt nearly drove Kent to lose his mind.
If she hadn’t put him to sleep, he would have become a monster for a limited time.
"Sorry, I made you ladies worried. It will never happen again," Kent said, wearing an apologetic expression. He is indeed sorry he made them worry about him.
"Don’t worry about it, Kent. We just want you happy and safe, so seeing you are safe now, we are happy," Nara said, brushing her hands across Kent’s hairless chest.
Since her boobs are acting as a pillow for the Chaos Dragon, she has his entire chest to herself.
Unity took a deep breath and asked, "But what happened, though? Although we are happy you are awake and safe, you got us worried, Kent."

Kent took a deep breath, his mind going back to the moment he snapped. "It was due to a side effect from one of the steps in my cultivation. However, now that it is out of the way, it will never happen again, at least for the time being."
"But it will happen again, right?"
"Probably. But I will work toward preventing it."
The ladies nodded, but they clearly are worried about him. However, for now, since he said he is fine and that it wouldn’t be for a while before he loses his mind again, they will believe him.

Kent sighed. He knew he would have to have his second blood cleansing bath again before forming his third core. This also means the counter, which is to form blood tattoos, will have to be on hold now.

chapters.title: Chapter 1174: Selene’s Dark Past
paragraphs: Obviously, being asked out of the blue whether they wanted to become Kent’s wives was unexpected and shocking.
That is rather true for the cat.
Indie, like Arien, has already told her family what she wants. Naturally, her family didn’t mind considering Kent is someone who saved them.
Princess Arien already told her father and mother, and they approved, too. They know Kent more.
However, for Indie, it was through Arien that she met Kent’s wives. She had spent some time with them and got to like their way of life.

At first, when she met them, she thought they were siblings, considering they all seemed to support each other. She saw the way they all tried to help one another just so they all could rise together.
She fell in love with that lifestyle and wanted to be a part of it.
The only problem, however, was that she had never met Kent before. She knew nothing about him. Yet, that didn’t stop her from falling in love with him.
Now, she had finally met him, and while it was brief, she was captivated by his good looks and strength.
One of her innate abilities allows her to use her cute little cat eyes to see things the way they are. She did see how monstrous Kent was. She also got to see how monstrous his legion was.
Now, she saw the one in charge of it all, and while his potential is nowhere near Vexthra’s, she was able to see the real Kent, and that turned her on.
Clearly, she fell in love with Kent’s strength, something she never knew was possible. Now, she had been offered the chance to become his forever.
However, it felt too sudden.
She turned to her friend Arien, and from the look on her face, she too felt it was sudden. Suddenly, they turned to the one who knew Kent better...
Lady Liora turned and looked at them too before shifting her gaze to the glass lady... Enzi.
"Don’t look at me." Enzi smiled and turned away. Her sisters laughed, knowing moments like this sometimes required one to make their own decision... or seek out a shameless Saintess.
Selene smiled and moved closer to the three ladies. She placed her hand on Indie and Arien’s shoulders.
Every last one of her sisters expected her to say something shameless. However, when she started to speak, they all turned quiet...
"I never told anyone this before. However, when I was 11 years old, I witnessed a man assault my big sister to death."
Selene turned and looked at Neomi, who seemed lost.
She then chose to speak to her, so while holding Indie and Arien, she started to reveal her dark past...
"My father was one shameless bastard who couldn’t stick to one wife. He used them and then dumped them. My mom was one of his many victims.
He started out as a loving father and supportive husband; however, once he had gotten what he wanted from you, he would dump you and throw you aside.
My mother gave birth to two of us. My sister was 4 years older than me. She was my best friend and pillar of support.
Back then, when my father offended some powerful cultivators, he chose to abandon us and run, saving his useless life.
One night, out of nowhere, the cultivators broke into our home and killed everyone. They spared no one. The men were instantly killed, including little boys, and the ladies were assaulted to death.
My sister was a very smart girl... perhaps too smart for her own good. That night, when everything was happening, instead of thinking about her own life, her entire focus was on me.

She could have escaped, yet she traded her place for me. In the heat of the moment, while helping me escape, she was captured and assaulted. I witnessed the entire ordeal, and that was when my fragile and innocent mind fractured."
Tears fell from her eyes, but she wasn’t the only one; her sisters were also crying.
"I’ve always believed in love and happiness, but that one gory night changed everything. My sister saved me, but at the cost of her life.
Later, I met Neomi at the orphanage, and while she looked just like my sister, her own childhood trauma was what brought us together.
I would be lying if I said we became friends and eventually sisters because she was a nice person. I became her friend due to our shared bitterness, and it was that bitterness that kept us going.

We killed all those who caused us pain... I hunted down my own father and killed him, hoping that would change anything, but the trauma seemed to have rooted its way into my heart by then. I was a lost cause, as most would say."
Selene let a painful smile appear on her face.

"You know, my big sister and I used to fantasize about our future back then. We both wanted to become wives of wealthy young heirs and, using our husbands’ money, open an organization where we would use any means necessary to punish unfaithful husbands."
Selene chuckled, and her sisters also smiled, wiping their tears.
"Thinking about it now, Atina should have stopped me from coming up with that silly idea."
Selene turned back to Indie, Arien, and Liora and said the words she meant to say...
"The point of all this was... I had given up on love... Shit, I hated seeing a man and a woman happy together. That was how bitter I was, and for a while, I lived it.
However, everything changed when I met Kent, and through his shamelessness and perhaps a moment of hesitation, I fell for him.
Because of him, I have known what love is. Because of these amazing ladies, I have regained my happiness again.
So becoming his wives is probably the best decision you will ever make."
An evil smile then crossed Selene’s face, prompting her sisters to welcome the real Selene back...

"Also, his dick is rather perfect, and damn, the dragon juice is natural and extremely sweet, so make the right decision, or else you will miss out on all the amazing orgies we will have in the future."
All the sympathy her sisters felt for her was wiped away by her shameless comment.
They could only shake their heads and hope she would change one day. Naturally, they knew she would never change, for this is who she is, and so they could only accept her as she was.
However, she seemed to have said what the ladies wanted to hear.
They all seemed to have made their decisions... even Lady Liora.
The ladies smiled and gave Selene a thumbs-up while Kent gave the mental command to the Tower to add the three ladies to the harem.
He then reached forward and took Selene’s hand, giving her a gentle squeeze. This was his way of telling them he was there for her.
Selene nodded and lay her head on his shoulder. This was her moment too, so she would enjoy it for as long as it lasted.
Her sisters didn’t mind. They themselves wanted to pamper her for a while.
After the ladies were added to the harem, Kent decided to speak about Elina, the lady who gave the Chaos Dragon his strength to rise and, in the end, save the entire universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1175: Elina
paragraphs: By making Arien, Indie, and Liora his wives, Kent is now free to speak about his life as the Chaos Dragon. After all, it was in that life that he met Elina, who changed his life forever.
And even after billions of years, she seems to still have a hold on his life.
"I know you ladies are still worried about what happened. I know I would be if it happened to any of you."
The ladies sighed, nodding slightly.
They kept their smiles, but deep within, they were worried about him. Thankfully, Tower managed to find the root and a way to lower their worry or even wipe it away for good.

"You all have to know that I am indeed fine. However, to make sure you truly understand what happened, I would have to tell you about someone who had, in a way, changed my life in ways nobody, not even the universe, saw coming."
The ladies quieted down and started to listen.
"I know most of you know I was once known as the Chaos Dragon." They nodded. The ladies who were hearing it for the first time and knew something about the Chaos Dragon became stunned.
Kent continued his narration since that was the least he could do... "I was indeed the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
However, while the universe painted my image as the most powerful existence to ever live, the truth was that all my power came from a place of pain and anger...
This pain, of course, came from a human lady called Elina."
Alina raised her brow, hearing her name mentioned. However, Kent just smiled. "Her name is Elina, but not the same as yours."
She nodded but was intrigued to hear that.
"Before I became famous, I was merely a battle-hungry dragon whose instincts were always to fight, kill, and ask questions later.
I single-handedly liberated my world, a small planet of beasts known as Lumen, from the tyrants who ruled it, becoming the planet’s protector.
Thanks to me, all those who dared to invade that planet were met with an unreasonable dragon who always went for the kill. I had killed thousands and was hungry for more.

However, that all changed when Elina and her people invaded Lumen as well. Back then, I tried to apply reason and talk to them; however, they looked down on me, so I killed them, except for one, who tried to reason with me.
Elina wasn’t like the rest of them. She was different, and in a way, she managed to catch my attention, and so I kept her alive.
Later, I got to know her, and slowly we learned to trust each other.
Once we became friends, Elina took me away from Lumen to experience life outside my small planet. I accepted the offer and left with her.

Eventually, I began to learn to be more human, and with Elina’s help, I started making human friends, something the real Chaos Dragon would never have become if he had remained in Lumen for even a few more years.
Elina taught me how to have empathy and cherish the help people rendered me." Kent smiled weakly.
"However, as you ladies may have already guessed, during the process of rehabilitating the most dangerous beast back then, Elina started developing feelings for Chaos.
The only thing was, Chaos had no idea what the subtle laughs, the hand-holding, and the small gifts meant. Naturally, it wasn’t his fault. The concept of love wasn’t in his nature.
However, he was also subconsciously developing feelings for Elina. Years later, they became the best of friends. However, to Elina, they were more than that.
Chaos never seemed to recognize her feelings, so when news came that the Forsaken Race had started their rampage, Elina had to send Chaos away to protect his planet.
She, too, had to protect her own world. Eventually, they parted ways.
However, it was after they parted that Chaos started to recognize his feelings. But with the threat of the Forsaken Race coming, he remained in his world.

Months later, after the Forsaken Race didn’t show up, he planned to go back to Elina. However, Elina had told him to stay behind for as long as it would take, just until the Forsaken Race threat had passed.
As it turned out, while Chaos was guarding his world, Elina was fighting for her life and that of her family and people. By the time Chaos became aware, it was already too late.
He only found her dead body. As it turned out, he truly loved her, and it was only after she died that he realized it. But the deed had already been done."
The ladies wiped their tears, while Unity seemed to have finally realized why the Chaos Dragon had been cold and distant when they met back then.

Of course, as ladies, they were saddened by what happened to Elina. They knew how loving Kent could be, so hearing his first existence had lost what was dear to him struck a chord of sadness in their hearts.

"I don’t like to say it like this, but it was thanks to her death that I realized my true strength. It was because of her death that the Chaos Dragon who rose up to become the pillar the universe leaned on was born."
"I am sorry, Kent. We didn’t know something that tragic happened to you," Unity, the sweet one, said, tears rolling down her cheek.
"It is not your fault, Unity... It is none of your faults," Kent wiped her tears and made sure she was okay.
"Elina is alive... She has reincarnated, and I was planning to go find her. I know where she is, but I have no idea whether she is safe and happy or if she is in pain.

That was why I lost it when I learned that a few friends I made thousands of years back are in danger in the Immortal Realm. It turned out, I subconsciously triggered my fear I had been suppressing, and that caused me to lose my mind."
"What planet is she on?" Vexthra asked, feeling sad.

"I don’t know, but I know she is in a galaxy called Astralis Veil. I already found a way to get close to the edge of this galaxy. I will soon find a way to cross over to that galaxy and hopefully get to her much faster."
Vexthra suddenly stood up. "I have to go back to the God Realm."
"Why?" Kent clearly didn’t expect to hear that.
"Crossing over a galaxy in a high world is super dangerous. The boundary between galaxies is known as Chaotic Space. Inside this space are beings known as Spatial Beasts.
They are just like the Forsaken Race; there are no limits on them, so you can even meet a god-level Spatial Beast there.
So I want to go ask a favor from the Space God and see if I can get him to help you cross over safely."
"Oh, I see." Still, he didn’t like it, but he knew Vexthra would go anyway, so the least he could do was allow her.
"Big sister, how long will you be gone for?"
"Just a couple of days on the outside, so for you ladies, about five months. If you will miss me too much, then you can go to the city and spend regular time there."
They nodded.
They all wanted Elina to be saved and brought back to where she belonged, so helping in any way they could was the best thing they could do.
"Also, I am not a Faceless Agent." Kent smiled mysteriously, telling them he heard all they had said while he was out.
"I was once known as the Faceless Assassin... you see?"

Back then, I tried to apply reason and talk to them; however, they looked down on me, so I killed them, except for one, who tried to reason with me.
Elina wasn’t like the rest of them.
She was different, and in a way, she managed to catch my attention, and so I kept her alive.
Later, I got to know her, and slowly we learned to trust each other.
Once we became friends, Elina took me away from Lumen to experience life outside my small planet.
I accepted the offer and left with her.

Eventually, I began to learn to be more human, and with Elina’s help, I started making human friends, something the real Chaos Dragon would never have become if he had remained in Lumen for even a few more years.
Elina taught me how to have empathy and cherish the help people rendered me." Kent smiled weakly.
"However, as you ladies may have already guessed, during the process of rehabilitating the most dangerous beast back then, Elina started developing feelings for Chaos.
The only thing was, Chaos had no idea what the subtle laughs, the hand-holding, and the small gifts meant.
Naturally, it wasn’t his fault.
The concept of love wasn’t in his nature.
However, he was also subconsciously developing feelings for Elina.
Years later, they became the best of friends.
However, to Elina, they were more than that.
Chaos never seemed to recognize her feelings, so when news came that the Forsaken Race had started their rampage, Elina had to send Chaos away to protect his planet.
She, too, had to protect her own world.
Eventually, they parted ways.
However, it was after they parted that Chaos started to recognize his feelings.
But with the threat of the Forsaken Race coming, he remained in his world.
Months later, after the Forsaken Race didn’t show up, he planned to go back to Elina.
However, Elina had told him to stay behind for as long as it would take, just until the Forsaken Race threat had passed.
As it turned out, while Chaos was guarding his world, Elina was fighting for her life and that of her family and people.
By the time Chaos became aware, it was already too late.
He only found her dead body.
As it turned out, he truly loved her, and it was only after she died that he realized it.
But the deed had already been done."
The ladies wiped their tears, while Unity seemed to have finally realized why the Chaos Dragon had been cold and distant when they met back then.
Of course, as ladies, they were saddened by what happened to Elina.
They knew how loving Kent could be, so hearing his first existence had lost what was dear to him struck a chord of sadness in their hearts.
"I don’t like to say it like this, but it was thanks to her death that I realized my true strength.
It was because of her death that the Chaos Dragon who rose up to become the pillar the universe leaned on was born."
"I am sorry, Kent.
We didn’t know something that tragic happened to you," Unity, the sweet one, said, tears rolling down her cheek.
"It is not your fault, Unity...
It is none of your faults," Kent wiped her tears and made sure she was okay.
"Elina is alive...
She has reincarnated, and I was planning to go find her.
I know where she is, but I have no idea whether she is safe and happy or if she is in pain.
That was why I lost it when I learned that a few friends I made thousands of years back are in danger in the Immortal Realm.
It turned out, I subconsciously triggered my fear I had been suppressing, and that caused me to lose my mind."
"What planet is she on?" Vexthra asked, feeling sad.
"I don’t know, but I know she is in a galaxy called Astralis Veil.
I already found a way to get close to the edge of this galaxy.
I will soon find a way to cross over to that galaxy and hopefully get to her much faster."
Vexthra suddenly stood up.
"I have to go back to the God Realm."
"Why?" Kent clearly didn’t expect to hear that.
"Crossing over a galaxy in a high world is super dangerous.
The boundary between galaxies is known as Chaotic Space.
Inside this space are beings known as Spatial Beasts.
They are just like the Forsaken Race; there are no limits on them, so you can even meet a god-level Spatial Beast there.
So I want to go ask a favor from the Space God and see if I can get him to help you cross over safely."
"Oh, I see." Still, he didn’t like it, but he knew Vexthra would go anyway, so the least he could do was allow her.
"Big sister, how long will you be gone for?"
"Just a couple of days on the outside, so for you ladies, about five months.
If you will miss me too much, then you can go to the city and spend regular time there."
They nodded.
They all wanted Elina to be saved and brought back to where she belonged, so helping in any way they could was the best thing they could do.
"Also, I am not a Faceless Agent." Kent smiled mysteriously, telling them he heard all they had said while he was out.
"I was once known as the Faceless Assassin... you see?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1176: New Mission
paragraphs: When Vexthra knocked Kent out, the tower used the moment to activate the three memory keys he had for the Faceless Assassin.
In those three parts of his past life memories, he experienced the planning and plotting moments that Faceless had to go through to kill a demon lord.
He experienced from the true expert the art of assassination. It was one of the intense moments and the experience that shaped Faceless Life. That finally awakened his nature as an assassin.
But it wasn’t just about witnessing how Faceless killed the demon lord; he got to relive the moment Faceless formed the Midnight Shadows.
It turned out the Midnight Shadows weren’t a fan group, as Kent had believed at first. In the memories he had recovered, when Faceless became an immortal, he realized the universe is big.
He alone wasn’t enough to handle the many threats there were, so he formed the Midnight Shadows, where he personally trained assassins from scratch.

He started with only seven, and by the time the memory ended, he had 60 assassins. Just before the memory ended, Kent, or more like Faceless, had created a variant of the Faceless Art and gave it to the first seven he started with.
However, he had it at the back of his mind to give it to more assassins.
This variant technique, just like the faceless art, also allows the assassin to take on the appearance of others. However, instead of becoming them, it only allows them to change their appearance.
However, unlike shapeshifting abilities that can be countered, this method truly captures the person’s appearance, voice, and even their memories.
However, they wouldn’t fully become the person they had killed, unlike the Faceless Art, which makes the assassin become that person.
Faceless named the assassins he gave this technique to, Faceless Agents, and judging by what he had heard his ladies discussing, the Faceless Agents are now a big deal.

This made Kent happy because he planned on using their daggers to rescue Kaelith. Though it would be a long shot simply because he didn’t know the arrangement he made with the Midnight Shadows before he died and reincarnated, he knew he would need them.
As strong as he is, he alone is not enough to rescue his friend and subordinate.
Kent’s wives could only look at him in a daze.
They’d already gotten used to him being the Chaos Dragon, but to think he was also the infamous Faceless Assassin.
That wasn’t something they expected.
Of course, he had already told Vexthra this part of himself, but to the rest of his wives, this was their first time hearing it.
Vexthra looked at her sisters and smiled... "No need to look shocked, he is a monster. I mean, he was also Lord Genesis... so nothing to be surprised about here, ladies."
They looked at Kent for a few seconds before Mara asked a question they all wanted to ask...
"Are there any more incarnations we should know about?"
Kent smiled, "Nothing yet, but I will be sure to let you ladies know."
They could only look at him like he was some ancient monster. In truth, he is indeed an ancient monster.
As a true primordial, he is perhaps the most ancient of them all. His nature and origin are ones that will project him to a stage no being, not even the six true primordials, had dared reach.
"Do you plan on going back to the Midnight Shadows?" Liora asked now that she knew who Kent was. She is a member after all.

"I will, but for now, I need to know more about myself before seeking them out. The assassins I trained aren’t going to casually accept just any no-name as their boss." Kent spoke with a knowing smile.
The ladies nodded.
They most certainly knew Kent going to his former organization, claiming to be their founder, was not going to be a walk in the park.
They would either kill him outright or put him to the test that perhaps he himself had designed. After all, Kent had already seen what kind of crazy trials he had created for his recruits.
Liora nodded, though her enthusiasm had taken a hit. Kent saw that, so he reassured her.
"I know where to get the answers I seek... I know where to begin, so no need to worry. After all, I need the Shadows to help me rescue a friend of mine, so I will seek them out soon enough.
However, before going to them, I must first know more about the life I had lived that made me who I was back then."
She smiled and nodded.
"So now what do you intend to do?" Nara asked. They all wanted him to go get Elina as early as possible...
She is a priority now, not some immortal locked in prison.

Of course, they wouldn’t dare say their inner thoughts out loud. However, as women, they tend to be more biased toward other women. If they have the chance, they will save Elina first before thinking about Kaelith.
"I will start my journey from the Pill Worlds. Once I take Liora to her home world, I will continue from there. I always have a roadmap, so I will follow it till I get to my destination."
"Then leave early. The faster you get to her, the better."
"Okay. I will leave since you ladies are sacking me."
None of the ladies bought into his mind game. They shooed him and started their own meeting. After Kent left the Harem Tower, he went to the Legion Tower to meet with Uncle Drew again.
He intended to find out more about Kaelith’s situation.
After hearing everything, he gave him a new mission.
"Go back to the Underworld. Tell Nyx to send you to the 6th level of Hell to pass a message personally to the current ruler there. He is a subordinate of mine.
The message must be delivered in person."
"I understand. I will start preparing then."

Kent nodded and let Uncle Drew go prepare. Since he was currently not at the level to contend against Immortals or Demigods, he wanted to use the strength he had accumulated in Hell to make some moves.
The Midnight Shadows were good and probably the best. However, Kent wanted to be extra prepared.
He knew what kind of training he had put his assassins through from the small memories he had, so he was not putting his hope in them to help him in the short term.
Getting to them will take time compared to hell.
He had already anticipated moments like this, and that was one of the many reasons he walked the hell road and defeated the 6th-level hell king. So he might as well tap into that strength.
Of course, if they could help him, then fine, but for now, he wanted to use the strength he had secured back when he defeated the 6th-level Hell King and became the ruling Hell King.
After Kent handled some other things in the Legion Tower, he left for the Mountain Garden, where Gaia and her sisters were working diligently to recreate a more stunning garden.
When he appeared there, they dropped everything and ran to him...

chapters.title: Chapter 1177: Leaving
paragraphs: "Big brother, are you leaving again?" Yuna asked, holding Kent’s hand.

She and Purity had become apprentices to the three cosmic troublemakers. Although they are not teaching them how to weave, since that is against the rules of the cosmos, they are teaching them how to use their skills much better.
In other words, instead of them breaking the rules, they are using the loopholes to teach the two immortal ladies how to harness their own power beyond what any cultivators could.
This is the best they could do, and that alone is enough to tell what kind of monsters they will become in the future.
However, while they are enjoying this new relationship, they would love to spend more time with Kent.
But seeing him so busy made them realise he might be leaving again.
Kent brushed Yuna’s dark hair and replied, "I am indeed leaving, but I will be coming into the tower every now and then to spend time with you. This time, I will not go years without coming back."
"Promise?"
Purity asked, and Kent nodded. "I promise."
"Okay, we believe you."
Kent smiled.
He didn’t know if it was Yuna’s Divine Pill Body that made her retain her petite body and her childish nature even after thousands of years.
Even when he rescued her years ago and brought her to Nefeli, she was older than he was. However, her personality and the way she carried herself were those of a child.
Kent at first thought it was because she never got to live as a normal lady should. He even expected that, after a few more years, she would catch up to her age.
But now, it seems she would always remain herself. In a way, that is okay. She has people like Gaia, Dori, and Akira, who are as old as the universe yet also childish.
Kent at first thought they were just acting, but as they spent more time together, he began to realize they were indeed childish in every way.
That is who they are, and he is okay with that.

However, seeing them easily accept his promise made him feel somewhat guilty. He knew this journey he was about to embark on would be long and dangerous. Sometimes he would have to go a whole year without meeting them.
That is a very long time inside the tower, unless, of course, they spend that time in the cities.
So, promising to come meet them every now and then might just not happen.
’It is okay. Even if I can’t come here, I will summon them to me. A few rides from one planet to the next will be fun enough.’
Since he takes the tower everywhere he goes, he will be able to summon them just as he can pop in whenever he wants.
After spending four hours with the five lolis, he left to go see his mom, who had been spending time with Adina and Priestess Runa.
It turned out Lyna chose to enter seclusion to learn a technique she acquired in the tower shop, so only the three ladies had been spending time the past month.
When Kent got there, they were having breakfast...
"Mom, you never even consider calling me to come eat breakfast with you."
Lady Enyo looked at her son walking towards her and smiled. "I am sorry, Kent, I didn’t know you were out of seclusion."
"Yeah. I came out of seclusion a while back, but I was handling some stuff. But I am now free, so I chose to come spend some time with you ladies before I leave."
"Where are you going?" Adina asked, a little sad.

Kent smiled, seeing her sad expression. He sat down beside his mom and reached to hold Adina’s hand. "I am just going on an adventure in a very faraway place. However, I will be coming by from time to time, so it will be like I never left."
"But you are still leaving without spending more time with us."
"I know, but I will try to spend more time with you and everyone, no matter how hectic things become."
Adina sighed a little and nodded. "I understand."
Kent smiled, knowing she was merely putting on an act.

He knew that, unlike the rest of the ladies he had met and added to his harem, Adina and Runa were different. They have the [Extreme Yin Body Constitution], which prevents them from having sex until they become immortals.
Until their constitutions finally awaken, they cannot have sex. If they did, their bodies would be tainted since the man would take away the purity that empowers them.
This means Kent cannot claim them now. So, to make them feel special, he would have to spend more time with them. However, he is bidding goodbye as he will be leaving for some time.
Naturally, that was a low blow to them.
Kent seemed to realise that, so he quickly found a fix.
"I know your situations, and while we cannot spend the time you would want together, we can at least start somewhere.
So, how about this: become my woman now so you can talk to me telepathically whenever you want, regardless of the distance between us.
I promise to work hard and soon ascend to the immortal worlds so we can be together more intimately."
His proposal seemed to have done the magic. Even his mother gave him a thumbs up for solving the problem she had been trying to solve for the past month.
"As long as it doesn’t involve sex, then I accept," Runa said, not hiding her intentions much longer.
"Me too. I would like to become your woman."
Kent smiled and willed the tower to add them to his harem. The moment he did, his wives appeared in the city like ghosts. Before he could say anything, they dragged Adina and Runa away.
"Wonderful, ladies, you have my dear pumpkin," Lady Enyo said, smiling happily for her son. The moody and sad Kent she knew had become much freer and happier in this life.
That alone filled her heart with happiness.
"They are indeed the best. However, they are fragile, so while I am gone, take care of them for me, Mom."
"Don’t worry, I will ensure they are okay. Just go handle whatever business you have to."
Kent nodded to his mom’s words.
"Come on, I have sewn you a nice set of clothing you will need for your journey." Kent nodded and followed his mom inside the small mansion Gaia and her band of troublemakers had built for her.
They see her as their grandma, so they are spoiling her rotten. Of course, since she seems to also cherish them, whenever they steal money from Kent, they spend it on her first.
This way, when Kent comes chasing, she will shield them.
After Kent finished receiving his new, modern yet medieval clothing, he left to say goodbye to his ladies before leaving with Liora and Selene.
Selene is coming simply because Kent wants to spend more time with her after learning about her bitter past. As for Liora, they are like newlyweds on their honeymoon.
Also, she is going home, so her husband will be making sure she reaches there safely.

chapters.title: Chapter 1178: Back To Pyris Pill World
paragraphs: "So, when are you leaving?" Kent asked Vexthra after sharing a few rounds with her. She was going back to the God Realm for a few days, so he wanted to make sure he sent her off well.
"I will leave tomorrow. I first have to make sure my new sisters have settled in and have received their rewards before leaving."
Now that Adina and Runa had also joined the harem, Vexthra wanted to give them a path as she did for the rest of her sisters.
Once that is handled, she can freely leave.
Of course, Kent would have to awaken their true names later. But until then, their growth lies in Vexthra’s capable hands.
Kent nodded and kissed her. Afterwards, they went one more round before he was ready to leave.
Liora and Selene were also ready to leave with him.
"I promise to come back into the tower every now and then to spend time with you ladies; that is especially true for you three."
Kent’s smile was at Arien, Indie, and Liora, causing them to smile.
Unlike Adina and Runa, who cannot have sex with him yet, they can, and since they are his women now, it was only right to spend some quality time together.
"We will be waiting for you," Arien said before hiding her face behind Indie. Kent smiled and made a mental note to come back soon to get to know them some more.
Since he had awakened his assassin abilities now, he could even spend some time with Indie on a mission, since she is also an assassin.
So for now, he would take every opportunity he could get to spend time with any of his wives.
’Come to think of it, taking them every now and then on missions will allow me to spend more time with them. Maybe I should do that instead.’
With his mind made up, Kent opened a portal using the Planet Teleporter, and soon, they were gone.
[Pyris Pill World]
It had been over 370,000 years since Kent had come to this planet. He planned to come back someday, but he never expected it to be this early.
Of course, to him, it is merely a few months since he had last been there. But in reality, hundreds of thousands of years had passed.
Now, he and his two wives had appeared somewhere in Pyris Pill World.
Kent quickly opened the Soul Map to see if he could recognise where they had appeared. It didn’t take long for him to realise which city they were in.
"We are in the capital, Pyris City."
"I think so too. It has been 6,000 years, but I recognise some buildings," Liora said, looking around. She was now dressed in green with her true Pill Monarch Badge hanging on her lapel.
Kent only found out about her true alchemy rank today when they were getting ready to leave.
It turned out she was not only a genius when it came to assassination, but she was also a good alchemist—something she learned just to blend in with everyone.
From Faceless’s memories, Kent learned that one of the requirements he set for the assassins he had recruited was to have two identities that could not be faked.

Thanks to the Faceless Art, he can become anyone he wants at any time. However, his team of assassins had to learn. So instead of them straining themselves to copy others, he made them all learn different crafts.
Some became blacksmiths, artisans, alchemists, and many more.

This way, if they wanted a blacksmith dead, sending another blacksmith would not only allow them to get closer to their target much faster, but even the target wouldn’t know there was an assassin after them.

When he killed the demon lord, he had to pose as an artisan for three years. By the time he got the job done, he had forgotten about himself. Thankfully, one day, perhaps thanks to his subconscious, he came back to his home world.
The moment he got back, he recovered his true self. So, he made it a must to always remember to come back there whenever he forgot who his true self was.
So, seeing Liora as a Pill Monarch didn’t come as a shock to him. If anything, he started to see her as a true assassin who deserved to become a Faceless Agent.
She was also one of his trump cards to get back to the top chairs of the Midnight Shadows.
"Let’s head to the Pyris Pill Pagoda. There is someone I need to talk to."
Neomi wanted to say something, but she held on, knowing Kent would find out soon enough.
They started moving toward the Pill Pagoda, still standing at the center of the city. Kent had been there multiple times in the past, so he was happy to be back again.
"This place is amazing. I can smell only pills. It is almost as if the air here is made of pill ingredients," Selene said, looking around.
All she could see were stores either selling ingredients or herbs. "However, I can’t help but notice all these stores have the same mark on them. What are these marks?"
Even Kent was puzzled by the same marks on every store they passed by.
"That is the mark of the current Supreme Pill Family ruling this pill world."
Kent frowned upon hearing this. "Can you elaborate more on this Supreme Pill Family?"
Liora nodded and started to tell Kent more about the nature of the pill world now.
"When I left 6,000 years ago, the Supreme Pill Families had already monopolised the pill market in all ten Pill Worlds. They had taken over every Pill Alliance and now call them Pill Families.
In this Pill World, the former Pyris Pill Alliance is now the Supreme Pyris Pill Family, led by a Pill Sovereign, with some even saying they have Pill Legend backing them.
They have taken over the entire pill market, monopolising the entire Pill Pagodas.
The only competitor they had was the Dream Pill Empire, said to have been set up by Lady Veth and her friends. They have long ascended, but her legacy and support remain.

But even so, the Supreme Pill Families are slowly swallowing her empire bit by bit. The Supreme Pyris Pill Family is the strongest of them all, thanks to the legacy left by the long-ascended leaders of the then Pyris Pill Alliance."
"Oh, so it is a shit show now." Kent didn’t want to show it, but he was pissed hearing what had become of the legacy he helped build.
"There are those who still believe in the dream of the Pill Alliances. However, with the resources taken by the Pill families, they don’t have any means to claim what is rightfully theirs."
Kent scoffed.
"They have crossed a line, haven’t they?" Selene asked, holding Kent’s hand. She didn’t care about the jealous looks people were flashing them.
She is super happy to be on this adventure with Kent.
"It will be either they pack out and leave, or I will kill every last one of them if that is what it’s going to take."
Recalling how his influence back then had set the Pill Alliances straight, he now seemed pissed that his efforts had turned into a mockery by these so-called Pill Families.
After a few minutes’ walk, they saw the Pill Pagoda. They quickly moved toward it. In no time, they arrived at its doors, where thousands of people were paying fees just to enter the pagoda.
This sight further angered Kent. The Pill Alliance, which he had left in Nefeli’s capable hands, had now become a mockery of its former glory.
"Unacceptable."
Kent took a step forward and appeared before the gate. His clenched fist moved, and like a bomb, he blasted the gate wide open.
The impact shook the entire pagoda, calling out the fools who think they can take over something he helped build...
