chapters.title: Chapter 1179: The Supreme Pyris Pill Family Fall
paragraphs: The moment the fist landed on the gate and destroyed it, powerful auras came from all nine levels of the pagoda surrounding Kent in an instant.
He coldly scanned all of them until his gaze landed on one of them. The bastard has an aura of evil around him. Kent immediately knew he had been killing people to make pills.
That was the only way an alchemist could have such a vile aura.
Kent’s cold gaze turned chilling.
He raised his hand and gestured down.
In an instant, the man with his Peak Heavenly Ascension stage cultivation crashed to the floor, his bones breaking under the bloodline pressure Kent was exerting.
With another gesture, the man’s head exploded like a balloon.
"My name is Kent Madson... Yes, that Kent Madson. I am a member of the Pyris Pill Alliance and would love it if you and your family pack out and leave.
I can give you an hour to do that, for which there will be no death. Disobey, and I will slaughter all of you, sparing not even the weakest of you."
Many shuddered, feeling their backs break into cold sweats.
Both the coldness in Kent’s eyes and the tone he spoke in felt so suffocating and dangerous.
"The Pyris Pill Alliance is no more. This is now the Supreme Pyris Pill Family. So it will be in your best interest to pack out and leave."
A Pill Monarch, about Kent’s age but Kent knew he was much older, said, taking a step forward. Three more Pill Monarchs followed him, though Kent could see the nervousness in their eyes.
If nothing concerned them, then the fact that they were facing the Kent Madson everyone had been searching for was enough to make them nervous.
For someone to become the target of everyone was already enough to tell what kind of existence they were.
Kent looked at the Pill Monarch for a few seconds before letting a small smile appear on his face.
"You know, 370,000 years ago, I took the liberty of dismantling the Blue Flame Pill Palace simply because they had colluded with the Evil Pill Sect.
Now, after many years have passed, it seems you losers still haven’t learned your lessons and still think that with the Evil Pill Sect backing you, you can become invincible.
In that case, allow me to offer you one more chance."
Kent turned and looked around him one more time. "Leave everything that belongs to the Pyris Pill Alliance behind, and vacate the premises in the next hour, else there will be hell to pay."
"What if we said no?" the Pill Monarch said again, a small smile playing on his lips.
Kent smiled. "You know, as long as you cannot call an immortal here, then even if there are millions of you, none will escape my wrath today."
The smile on the Pill Monarch’s face froze. However, he recovered and broke the pendant behind him. Immediately, more powerful auras filled the area.
In no time, the entire entrance of the Pill Pagoda became filled with tens of thousands of warriors and alchemists.

Seeing this many people surrounding Kent, the Pill Monarch sneered. "Go down on your knees and beg for your life. A mere Spirit Sovereign dares disrespect an entire Supreme Pill Family... the number one Pill Family in all Ten Pill Worlds."
He smirked and raised his hand, summoning a primordial flame.
"Wow, that is a primordial flame." The people who were trying to get into the Pill Pagoda before Kent arrived seemed mesmerized by the primordial flame the Pill Monarch had summoned.
Kent, however, seemed even more mad seeing his hard work being used by a bastard. The primordial flame was left by him.
The seven flame monarchs brought back hundreds of primordial flames. Before he left, he gave 40 to the Pyris Pill Alliance.
Now, it seems these losers have taken everything. Kent’s patience immediately ran out...
"So, in other words, you losers won’t be leaving as I suggested, right?"
"You’re damn right."
Kent smiled and turned toward Selene and Liora. "Make sure none of them run away."
The two ladies nodded.
"Since you have made your decision, then wiping you out is the only way," Kent summoned Gaap, who was already radiating an intense Blood Sword aura.
"Allow me to rip your lives then."

Kent moved, and heads started flying into the air. He was not holding back, so aside from a few who could see him move in a blur, almost 90% only seemed to notice him after their heads shot into the air.
In no time, the scent of blood filled everywhere.
With every head falling to the ground, golden blood essence moved and entered Kent’s forehead. Since they brought themselves, he could only slaughter them.
The Pill Monarch, who had spoken and even summoned the reinforcement from the Evil Sect, stood in shock, his fragile legs shaking like a twig.

He wanted to run, but his willpower happened to be rather weak, so he lost the ability to even move. He could only watch as the thousands of people who made his family the strongest in all Ten Pill Worlds were being slaughtered one by one.
"STOP!"
Suddenly, a Pill Legend followed by three Pill Sovereigns appeared from the 9th floor and flew toward where the massacre was happening.
Kent didn’t even glance at them. He had given them the chance, and they didn’t take it, so now they could only blame themselves.
"I SAID STOP!" the Pill Legend shouted again.
"He cannot hear you," Selene suddenly said, standing not far from the Pill Legend.
Liora also smiled, and in a mocking tone, she said, "When he is in combat, words like ’Stop’, ’I surrender’, or ’Please spare me’ cannot be heard by him. He is deaf to those words."
"What she said is indeed true. So if you want his attention, you can take up arms and try to kill him. We will not stop you."
"But we will stop you from running, so choose. Go after our man and try to kill him, or run, and we will kill you."
The Pill Legend and the three Pill Sovereigns swallowed nervously, taking a few steps back.
They turned and looked at Kent, who was ripping lives while absorbing the blood essence of his kills, and all they could do was take their chances with the ladies.
So they made a run for it. However, before they could even move ten meters, all three Pill Sovereigns lost their heads to Liora’s daggers.

As for the Pill Legend, Selene pointed her sword at him and spoke in a somewhat regretful tone, "Killing a Pill Legend is indeed a loss. However, having a scum Pill Legend running the show is also a shit show, so you can only blame your life choices."
With that, a pillar that almost all pill stores depended on was beheaded.
"Don’t worry about it. He isn’t the only Pill Legend in this world. The then Pyris Pill Alliance had two Pill Legends. I am sure they will be arriving here anytime soon."
Liora calmed her sister down and then focused back on Kent, who had already killed 90% of the people and was now wrapping up things.
After a few minutes, Kent was done. He appeared before the Pill Monarch and flashed him a mocking smile.
"I’ve already given you a chance to surrender the pagoda back to me, but you thought with numbers and support from some no-names, you stood a chance."
Kent shook his head, then he gave him a cold line of words, "You can die now."
Kent tapped him on the forehead, and his entire body was engulfed in green flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 1180: Sending a Message
paragraphs: Watching the leader of a Supreme Pill Family screaming his lungs out, everybody gathered there felt their backs break into cold sweats.
The scene is just too unbelievable.
They had on many occasions seen how powerful the head of the Supreme Pyris Pill Family was. He had, after all, demonstrated his power by banning many stores and families from getting pills.
He had even made it so that many people could only buy from his family. Because of this, not only had he become someone feared by many, but his words were supreme in the ten Pill Worlds.
The power he commanded was something surprisingly close to an immortal.
However, such a powerful figure was now burning like a bush, and all anyone could do was step back and sweat from sheer fear.
There is no other emotion around other than sheer fear and terror.
"This is too much... They are all dead."
"Indeed. This is too much."
"Tch, what is too much? These bastards killed my brother, who had just become a Pill Monarch, simply because they wanted the primordial flame that the then Pyris Pill Alliance gave him.
They are wicked, and I, for one, am darn happy these bastards got what they deserve."

"Same here. They blacklisted my pill store and even threatened to kill my family if I didn’t hand over my top customers to them. I wanted them dead, and it seems the universe has answered my prayers."
"Same here."
"Me too... They deserve what they got."
Many people were happy that the era of the Supreme Pyris Pill Family had finally come to an end. The tyranny that had negatively impacted the lives of the masses had finally been eradicated.

Now, it seemed everyone was super happy. Of course, there were those who sympathized with the Supreme Pyris Pill Family; however, they were powerless to do anything—not when Kent had singlehandedly killed them all.
Nobody knew a day like this would ever come; however, now that it had, everyone started to see the dawn of a new beginning for them.
As soon as the man died, Kent formed hand seals, and all their space rings, primordial flames, and techniques they had hidden flew toward him and vanished into thin air.
Kent turned to everyone and started to speak...
"I won’t say much, so you all should listen. Send a message to the other Pill Families and tell them they have a day to put everything they came to meet down and leave.

I do not want to come and meet even a single one of them. Of course, those who wouldn’t listen and even dare take a single pill recipe away, I will spend great time and resources to hunt them down and kill every last one of them."
People took several steps back.
Perhaps, due to how rapidly he had absorbed the blood essence from the people he had killed, his tone and body movements seemed to scream danger.
Hearing his words made them all fear for their lives.
"They have a day to scram, else they can only blame themselves."
After saying that, Kent turned in the direction he and Nefeli went when he wanted to speak with the Grand Pill Tablet.
"NANA..."
Kent called out in a commanding tone.
Suddenly, a powerful explosion rocked the mansion that used to belong to the Pyris Pill Alliance, sending it crumbling. Then, from the ruins, a stone tablet flew toward Kent.
When it got close, everyone’s eyes widened. The tablet stopped before Kent...
"That is the Grand Pill Tablet." Those who had the privilege to see the Grand Pill Tablet recognized it the moment it flew toward Kent.
However, to their shock, the moment the tablet reached Kent, it turned into a white-haired loli. Her beauty instantly captured everyone’s attention.
Nobody had the faintest idea how something everyone regarded as the backbone of the Pyris Pill Alliance turned out to be a human, and from the look of things, she seemed familiar to Kent.
Whispers and murmurs started to spread, but Kent and Nana ignored them.
At the moment, she was a ghost body, so she could not hold hands with Kent.
But she could talk, so that was enough...
"Long time no see, Nana," Kent said, wearing a small smile.
"It is good to see you too, Master." Naturally, Nana was more than happy to finally reunite with her master. After all, she had waited many years just for this moment.
"I guess now that I am here, we can go get the other nine parts to finally make you whole. These people don’t deserve your generosity anymore."
Nana nodded.
Truth be told, she never wanted to divide her body into ten parts. She only did that to remain useful while she waited for her master.
Another reason was that he wanted to keep helping Alchemist across the universe, as her master, the divine Pill Sage, did.
But now that Kent was back, she couldn’t care less about the ten Pill Worlds.
Selene and Neomi moved toward Kent and Nana.
"Another one?" Selene instantly asked, flashing Nana a broad smile.
Kent, who understood what she was hinting at, smiled and turned away. This only gave Selene the chance to tease him some more.
"You must have done some good to the loli goddess to make her gift you all the cute and adorable lolis in the universe."
Kent smirked...
But he couldn’t refute Selene’s shameless words. He indeed had his fair share of lolis.
First was Li Hua, who had now come of age, and to fulfill the promise she made to Kent when he saved her years ago, she began training to become a powerful assassin.
She didn’t even take breaks.
Back then, learning that she had the Atomic Divine Body made him think he would have to spend time with the smallest human he had ever seen; however, Gaia appeared not long after.
Then Akira also appeared, and before long, Dori joined them.
Now, Yuna and Purity had also joined them, and from what they told him, they weren’t leaving anytime soon.
Now, Nana would be joining them, making seven lolis, and there was no telling if she would be the last. In a way, this was more than he could ask for, considering he had already packed seven of them.
So, in a way, Kent was indeed blessed with lolis.
’I should explore the main reason behind this and see if I can figure out why this is happening to me,’ Kent sighed and added, ’Not that I mind, since all of them are amazing in their own way.’
After making up his mind, he decided to handle that later. For now, he had sent a warning and would follow up.
Kent turned back to everyone.
"All members of the Pyris Pill Alliance should meet me here tomorrow morning."
After saying that, they flew into the Pagoda and went straight to the 9th floor. Nana had been living in the Pill World for many years, so she knew every last member of the Pyris Pill Alliance.
She would help him pick a new Alliance Head and, this time around, ensure nothing bad would happen ever again.
The Pyris Pill Alliance was a place where he had made some great gains, so he would most certainly not let it be destroyed by some ambitious families.

The scene is just too unbelievable.

There is no other emotion around other than sheer fear and terror.
"This is too much...
They are all dead."
"Indeed.
This is too much."
"Tch, what is too much?

"Same here.

"Same here."
"Me too...

chapters.title: Chapter 1181: Effect
paragraphs: "What did you just say?" the patriarch of the Supreme Solaryn Pill Family asked, veins popping on his bald head.
"My Lord, a person claiming to be Kent Madson had stormed the Supreme Pyris Pill Family and slaughtered every last one of them. He also sent a message that he had given us an hour to vacate, else..."
The man’s gaze turned cold.
He clearly didn’t like what he was being told.

He, after all, was the head of the second biggest and most powerful pill family in the ten Pill Worlds, so hearing he was being commanded to vacate where he called home clearly didn’t sound or taste well to him.
However, the threat was significant—one he could not afford to ignore.
He knew deep down that he was in the wrong. Seventy thousand years ago, he and nine other Pill Families attacked the Ten Pill Alliances, and overnight, they took over.
It was a shock to many, but they moved quickly, and before long, they had taken over the businesses and channels of the then Nine Pill Alliances.
They killed many people to secure their position, so they knew this threat wasn’t going to be a walk in the park. There was even evidence showing that Kent meant business.
"Send a message to the people. We must handle this brat before he grows a pair."
Obviously, he and his people would not be vacating as Kent had instructed.

The one who gave the report on what had happened to the Supreme Pyris Pill Family nodded and left, unaware that whatever they said had already been conveyed to Kent, and he would be visiting them next.
Nana had one of her parts in that Pill World, so she was reporting everything that was happening there to Kent.

Before Kent came to the Pill World years back, the Solaryn Pill Alliance was the top rank in all Ten Pill Worlds; however, after Kent came and elevated the image of the Pyris Pill Alliance, they dropped to second place.
So naturally, now that the Pill Families had taken over, they were the second strongest Pill Family, and as such, they wouldn’t bend the knee without a fight.
And they weren’t the only ones. The Fourth and Seventh Pill Families also chose to stand their ground. They even started calling their allies and banding together to take care of Kent.
Aside from that, others who were also interested in Kent in all the bad ways had already started making their way to Solaryn, where Kent would have no choice but to come.
Of course, those who wanted to catch his favor would also try their best to please him. In a way, coming to Planet Solaryn was a must; after all, it was also the planet closest to Neomi’s home world.
As for the intelligent ones, they quickly vacated as instructed.

Meanwhile, instead of panicking, Kent was more than relaxed despite the odds mounting against him. He was not scared in any way. After all, he had more than enough warriors under his command to use in the upcoming battle.
He was not worried in the least.

He had already experienced how powerful he was, so he was even looking forward to their next bout. Of course, that didn’t mean he was bloodthirsty to the point he didn’t know when to be civil and when to be chaotic.
In fact, under normal circumstances, considering what the Pill Families had done—the number of alchemists they had killed just to rise to power—Kent shouldn’t have even given them an hour to pack up.
He should have killed every last one of them, for they had hurt many people.
However, Kent, despite his bloodthirsty nature, chose to walk the path Unity wanted for Chaos in this life. Thankfully, he had more than enough emotional support.

His mother was also there to keep him straight, so at the moment, he was a rational human/dragon who chose to give his enemies a chance to keep their lives. Those who disobeyed, he, of course, would kill as compensation for the pain they had caused.
Kent, his wives, and Nana decided to wait for the true members of the Pyris Pill Alliance that were driven out to come so he could put things in place properly this time around.
In the meantime, he decided to find out all that had transpired when he left three hundred seventy thousand years ago.
"When the master left, Lady Nefeli became the leader who oversaw that everything was left in good hands. They destroyed the Evil Pill Sect as you instructed.
After that, they purged all the filth from the various Pill Alliances, making for the first time a peaceful and true Pill World.
I was happy, and everyone was happy.
They even gave the Nine Pill Worlds four Primordial Flames each. Of course, because of the limited number of Primordial Flames, they cultivated them into intelligent flames.
I gave them the technique and recipe to do that. This way, everyone could use them without anyone owing them. It was one of the best moments for the Ten Pill Worlds.
However, after they ascended and the next six generations of alchemists also left, the ambitious Pill Worlds decided to seize everything.
Of course, I intervened somehow and helped some promising alchemists escape. However, many died.
Since then, the Ten Pill Worlds had gone downhill. The Evil Sect had also resurfaced about forty thousand years ago, making things even worse.
So that is what happened after you left."
"I know it’s been hard on you, Nana, but thank you for caring for the Alliances. Now that I am here, I will make sure this never happens again."
Nana nodded her small head.
She had indeed done well, considering she was not even whole. If it hadn’t been for her, many would have died.
However, now that Kent knew what had indeed happened, the idea of sparing any of them seemed to become a mistake in his mind.
However, he had already promised to spare those who would take his generosity, so he would fulfill that promise. However, the Evil Pill Sect would soon be completely eradicated.
After a couple of hours, the important members of the Pyris Alliance arrived, and Kent commenced the meeting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1182 - 1179 - Pyris Pill Alliance Re-established
paragraphs: Kent was surprised that on such short notice, Two Pill Legends, three Pill sovereigns, and seven Pill Monarchs that used to be members of the Pyris Pill Alliance would heed his call and come running this quickly.
However, they came, and it was thanks to their love and passion for Alchemy.

Three hundred seventy thousand years ago, Nefeli told him that the Pill Alliances were established to ensure every living soul could buy a pill at affordable prices. Their mission was to use Alchemy to improve the quality of life in the universe.
So when these people were called, they came knowing their vows to make Alchemy first over everything was their strongest suit now.
"Thank you all for coming." Since thousands reported, he chose to meet the top rankers.
"We are glad to be called back here. None of us had dreamed a day like this would ever come," one of the Pill Legends, an Elven lady called Terra, said, her expression calm and collected.
Of course, the happiness in her voice could not be missed. She was darn happy, and everyone could see and also feel it.
I mean, who wouldn’t be happy to see their enemies and oppressors crash beneath the feet of someone claiming to be Kent Madson?
There was no telling whether he was indeed the Kent Madson they had all been looking for, but they were happy he had finally liberated them from their oppressors.
That was just too much for any of them to keep their emotions bottled up.
"Well, we are here now, and the Pill Family is no more. That is more than enough to be happy about. However, we have to ensure the Pill Alliances never die, and that begins with this alliance."
They nodded to Kent’s words and listened to what he had to say.

"Years ago, when Pill Monarch Nefeli added me to the Pyris Pill Alliance, her dream was to create a powerful and quality Pill World where, when it comes to Alchemy, nobody should lack, no matter what they want.
She had done that, and from what I learned, the last six generations had followed in her footsteps. That is enough reason to know it can be done again.
So this time, I plan to personally set up the power dynamics here. I will personally select the leaders and ensure the dream envisioned by your predecessors lives on.
Of course, this time around, I will make sure the Pill Families never happen again. I will make sure, before they even entertain the idea, every last one of them loses their heads."

The Alchemists gathered in the Ninth Level of Hell shuddered upon hearing Kent’s words. They were already afraid of him. However, because this was a safe meeting he called, they were not worried he would snap and kill them.
Even so, they were scared of him, and that was enough reason to tell them how serious this meeting and his words were.
"I have already done my background research on every last one of you, so I will select the next Pill Leader and then set up the structure and power dynamics from there."
Kent went ahead and selected the next Pill Leader for the Pyris Pill Alliance and then started from there. He chose those who would manage the alliance’s various affairs.
This time, instead of giving them pill recipes, he gave them techniques to use. These techniques, of course, came from Nana, who knew everything about Alchemy.
He also implemented some safety measures, most of which were private, making it so that no matter what, the enemy would never see him coming.
Of course, he knew the human mind is susceptible to manipulation and greed, so there is no telling what any of these people would do.
They could one day choose to collude with another Pill Family to cause mayhem here and there, like their predecessors did, causing the deaths of tens of thousands.
However, he had already put measures in place to prevent that.

"Remember, making any attempt to betray this alliance will, if not immediately, then painfully eat at your life and slowly worm its way into your heart, which I promise will be excruciating and painful to the point you will cry, but tears will not come because you have already cried every living tear out of your body.
However, when you think that is all, you will be mistaken, because my plan is to kill you in the most painful way possible.
So remember that before you choose to betray this humble alliance. Trust me, this time around, even if I am millions of miles away, I will know what is happening here, and as such, I will come."

Kent smiled and shook his head. "Of course, you are free not to believe me now, but fear not. The day will come, and I will make sure when it does, there will be no second time to reconsider anything."
They nodded like obedient children.

Kent nodded, but inwardly, he couldn’t believe he would be saying such cringeworthy words ever in this life. He knew that threatening these people could be done quietly and privately; however, he had no plans to implement any security measures just yet.
He may have made a pit stop in this place simply because he had to, but he had no plans on staying here for long.
If asked what was going on, he would say saving Elina was several times more important than saving the Pill Worlds.
However, since he was here, he would make sure to set things straight before leaving. The fact that he even arrived here when he did was already fated.
After he added a few details to his plans and the power structure of the newly reestablished Pyris Pill Alliance, the meeting ended.

Within a few hours, the alliance resumed operations. Many who were late to the meeting were brought up to speed, and, well, they had no choice but to accept and hope that this new alliance would thrive into a good and prosperous one.
The last thing he did was give them the Primordial Flames. This time, however, no one person would have it, just like Nana did for the other alliances back in the day.
The Pill Flames would have intelligence as they should, so that whenever any of the top-ranking members of the alliance wanted to make high-quality pills, they could use them.
It was all sound and amazing—one that, if managed well, would not only last the Pill Alliances a lifetime but would uplift the image of the Pill Worlds yet again.
After that was done, Kent left Planet Pyris and headed to Solaryn, where thousands, perhaps millions, were waiting for him.

The Pill Flames would have intelligence as they should, so that whenever any of the top-ranking members of the alliance wanted to make high-quality pills, they could use them.
It was all sound and amazing—one that, if managed well, would not only last the Pill Alliances a lifetime but would uplift the image of the Pill Worlds yet again.
After that was done, Kent left Planet Pyris and headed to Solaryn, where thousands, perhaps millions, were waiting for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1183: Past Defeat
paragraphs: "So, are you going to kill them all?" Selene asked, resting her head on Kent’s shoulder as they flew in a colossal ship through the teleportation tunnel leading to Planet Solaryn.
Liora was also resting in a similar fashion.
Kent let a smile appear on his face as he answered, "You know, since I have killed the Supreme Pyris Pill Family, it would be only right to kill them too.
I mean, they had, after all, offended me by coming against me and what they shouldn’t have touched."
"I know, however, isn’t there a better way to handle this? They, after all, are alchemists... I feel like killing them all will be a huge loss to the Ten Pill Worlds."

Selene tried to reason with Kent, who deep down knew that killing even a Pill Monarch is a huge loss to the Pill Society. However, he also could not bring himself to consider them as not guilty. They had, after all, killed thousands of innocent alchemists just to rise to power.
That was unforgivable.
However, the loss outweighed the gain here.
Kent took a deep sigh...
"Let me tell you a story." Kent took both Liora’s and Selene’s hands into his and began narrating his story.
"I had just killed the most unkillable Demon Lord and had gained so much fame despite nobody knowing who my true self was. However, they were happy simply because I killed a tyrant.
I was happy too.
However, what nobody knew was that before getting to the Demon Lord, I had to kill thousands. He was that protected, and so I had to be creative and precise.
I succeeded in the end, but it turned out I failed too." Kent sighed, his mind going back to his life as the faceless assassin and the loss he had suffered back then.
"You see, in the process of killing my way to the Demon Lord, I spared his youngest daughter, who at that time was just sixteen years old.
Her father was a tyrant, and her siblings were evil. However, after spending so much time studying her, I found her to be innocent, so I spared her.
Many would have killed her just to prevent future problems. However, even my cold heart couldn’t bring itself to kill her, and so it backfired.

You see, not long after I completed my mission, the innocent demon girl proved not to be too innocent after all. One fateful day, news spread everywhere that the youngest and only living daughter of the dead tyrant had colluded with the Demon Poison Clan, and they poisoned the planet I had saved from the tyrant Demon Lord.

Less than ten percent of the billions that lived there had survived that ordeal. Children, mothers, pregnant women, and many more died simply because I decided to show compassion, mercy, and kindness.
My decision to spare the spawn of a tyrant cost the lives of thousands, and it was my fault. I could have prevented it, yet I didn’t, and that was on my hands.

So sure, I can choose to spare these people. I can even choose to let them be. However, tomorrow, they will turn their gaze toward the next business, the next alchemist, and before you know it, many lives will be destroyed.
Sure, I can find another way to sack them, but then they will come back ten times more powerful. What happens when they choose to come back and this time kill everyone?

This is why I will kill every last one of them. Then, using their blood, I will send a piercing message—one that will ensure nobody dares entertain the idea of ever coming against the Ten Pill Worlds."
Selene and Liora could only look at Kent, not out of fear, but out of concern for his mental health.
Remembering such a severe failure surely wasn’t pleasant. He had saved the world only for a mistake he made to come back and bite him in the ass.
Sure, sparing the lady was the right thing to do. Keeping her out of the slaughter he committed was the right thing to do.
However, because of that one good deed, billions died, and that was his fault, no matter how he wanted to see it.
So he promised himself he would never make such a mistake again. This time, when he saw a threat, he would make sure it was handled before it escalated into something even more severe.
"We understand," Selene said, and Liora nodded.

Kent nodded and then said in a calm tone, "Of course, I will give them enough time to save themselves. However, those who wouldn’t listen will have to answer for their crimes, and for that, I will not spare even a single one of them."
The ladies nodded.
Kent smiled and kissed Selene. After breaking the kiss, he turned to Liora and kissed her too. "You ladies can go inside the tower and wait for me there if you don’t want to witness the bloodbath."
They shook their heads, and Liora replied, "We will stand by your side and make sure you get it done. We are your wives, so supporting you unconditionally is our job."
"Liora is right. We are your wives, so don’t for one second think we will let you handle something this important alone. We will stand by your side through it all."
Kent smiled and nodded. "Then I will be counting on your support."
They resumed their kiss. Soon, time passed, and they were drawing near to their destination.
Meanwhile, back on Planet Solaryn, thousands had gathered at the Solaryn Pill Pagoda. They were the ones who came to resist Kent and show him he was nobody in this Pill World.
Of course, a few curious ones had already found good vantage points to watch from. Many were from the Immortal Worlds.
They came looking for Kent, and now that they knew where he would be, they came to see what he could do and whether they would get lucky enough to meet him and try to learn more about him.
Of course, they were after the reason why his name appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet. But for now, they would stand by and observe.
A couple of hours later, Kent and his wives, Liora and Selene, arrived on Planet Solaryn.

chapters.title: Chapter 1184: Cleaning The Pill Worlds (1)
paragraphs: The teleportation gate Kent and his wives arrived at isn’t that far from the Pill Pagoda, so the moment they arrived, the soul map gave him a clear picture of what awaited him.
He shared the view with his wives, who only shook their heads as they watched thousands, perhaps millions, stand and wait for their doom.

"Sometimes, I don’t get it," Selene said, her expression showing a lost look. "These people clearly heard and perhaps even saw the massacre that happened in Pyris. That was a clear sign for them to run for their dear lives, yet here they are, waiting for something deep down most of them had no business being here for."
Liora smiled and said, "They are a lost cause. I have already seen people far more stupid and dangerously arrogant simply because they believe they have the upper hand after being on top for a while.
Just because under the Pill Families, they faced no opposition, they let that cloud their judgment, so they think they are the ones in charge here.

Not that they are mistaken, it is normal for them to feel that way. They have held the power for a while now, so they are not afraid of anyone. The only downside is they are coming against someone like Kent, who is not afraid of the odds."

The two ladies turned and looked at Kent, who seemed calm and composed despite there being thousands of Heavenly Ascension Stage warriors waiting for him with all kinds of weapons ready to take him on.
"Let’s go. They aren’t going to kill themselves."
They soon left the teleportation gate and headed for the pagoda, where the thousands of alchemists, their guards, and reinforcements were gathered and waiting for them.
In no time, they were only a few km away. Naturally, many had already sensed him, so they started to get ready. Kent and his wives came to a stop when they were only 2 km out.
At once, thousands of people encircled them.
All of them were ready to kill, so when they saw the person who threatened them, they rushed to create a barricade around him.
Kent remained calm, his expression not showing any panic. Naturally, Liora and Selene were the same. They had no fear in their eyes.ree
A Pill Legend walked forward, his shoulders held high as he addressed Kent in a somewhat arrogant tone.
"Brat, you still have a chance to die swiftly since we are being merciful today. All you have to do is bow and ask for forgiveness.
That will give you a swift and decisive death." His arrogant words have given the thousands surrounding Kent hope and the energy to attack when they give the order.
Kent looked at the man with a smile.
This sight angered him; however, Kent didn’t give him the chance to continue.
He merely snapped his fingers, and one of the sword realms under his disposal activated.
At once, thousands of broken swords made from sword aura appeared in the air and encircled the Pill Legend.
He immediately turned pale. Sweat painted his face and back.

Thousands took several steps back, the feeling of dread enveloping them. Naturally, since Kent had merged his blood qi with his sword aura, whenever he used it, both the sharpness of a sword and the dreadful feeling of blood filled the air.
This feeling of dread now seemed to have enveloped everyone, making them all break out in cold sweats.
Kent turned to the Pill Legend and smirked before he said, "Why don’t you chill for now? I came here for her."
Kent pointed at a lady wearing a veil standing far back in the crowd.

"You are the current leader of the Evil Pill Sect, right? Don’t ask me how I know, I just do. However, since you are here, it means you came with the intention of ending me, so why don’t you come after me directly and let these idiots go?"
The veil lady maintained her calm expression; however, she was taken aback by how easily Kent found her out. That wasn’t exactly how she wanted things to go, but in a way, Kent had figured her out.
Of course, she chose to play calmly; however, things were not as simple as they seemed, especially when someone like Kent was involved.

"Your name is Luna Ovidia. You came from a planet far from this place. Naturally, you and the main leaders of the Evil Sect all want to take over the entire Pill Worlds and use them to make evil pills that will be sent to your employer, the Evil God, Morissa."
Kent chuckled, "Too bad you met me, since after today, there will be no Evil Sect nor evil pills."
Kent moved, and within 2 seconds, he appeared in 14 places. By the time he returned to his original position, 14 heads lay on the ground.
He used just 500 flame veins, but because of his current cultivation base, his speed was several times faster than one would expect.

The veiled lady broke into a cold sweat and was about to make a run for it when a dagger was pressed against her neck. "Be a dear and don’t make things difficult for yourself." Liora had long made her move, knowing her man will have a use for her.
Kent turned to the thousands gathered.
"Those who want to leave, you have a minute to distance yourself further from this place. After a minute, I will spare no one."
Hearing what Kent said, thousands started to run, yet thousands remained standing. They were, of course, from the Evil Sect and some devoted members of the Pill Families.
They wouldn’t run, not when they were being threatened by a brat and his two wives. Of curse, the evil sect members wouldnt run when their leader is at the mercy of Liora, the Scarlet Angel
Naturally, they regretted that decision since after a minute, Kent started his massacre like he promised.
Strangely, those who stayed couldn’t even move their fingers, so they merely remained standing as Kent killed them rather easily.
By the time the last of them was cut down, Kent broke through to the Spirit Lord Stage and even managed to climb to Level Three.
It was a devastating massacre, one that left those who ran to wipe the idea of ever coming against the Pill Worlds off their minds.
Once things were settled, Kent mind-controlled the Evil Sect leader, who would take his legion to all the hideouts of the Evil Sect, where they would kill all members of the Evil Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1185: Cleaning The Pill Worlds (2)
paragraphs: "Rest assured, master, we will make sure every last one of them is sent to the afterlife," Kaizo said, standing beside the mind-controlled leader of the evil sect.

"I know you will." Kent would have loved to be the one who would take on the mission and kill every last member of the evil sect; however, since he has a more pressing mission at hand, he is letting Kaizo and the legion handle it.

"Be careful, though. There is a god behind the evil sect, and if she catches wind of what is happening, she might just send down her wrath, so be on high alert and always run into the tower when there is danger."
"We will, master."
Kent nodded. He isn’t afraid of his people failing to complete this mission, he knew they will get it done.
What he is more afraid of is them coming on the radar of the evil goddess, the true mastermind behind the evil sect.

Although there will be backlashes for interfering in mundane affairs as a goddess, the backlash also wouldn’t kill them, so most gods will risk it and send down their divine wrath on those who would mess with them.
This is why Kent is skeptical about giving the mission to them.
However, he knew that to get the job done, he must make sure every last member of the evil sect is dead.
Many years ago, after he killed the planet king, who at that time was the leader of the evil sect, Nefeli and the others merely attacked the headquarters of the evil sect.

Of course, they managed to purge the evil sect; however, there were many branches left to sever back then, so the evil goddess tapped into them and brought the evil sect back, much bigger and more evil than before.
So this time, Kent plans to let his people take care of them down to the last leaf. This way, rising back up will be next to impossible.
Of course, the evil sect will always find its way back up, but it wouldn’t be for another thousands of years.
By then, Kent will find a better way to make sure the ten Pill Worlds are safe from them.
Also, his influence will spread far and wide by then, making sure the evil sect thinks a million times before directing their gaze toward just anyone.
"Master, once Goddess Vexthra returns, we will challenge the 5th floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon. I have already informed Uncle Drew before he left for the underworld.
Also, Uncle Drake reached out; he said he is on his way to a planet not far from this place, so we will meet up with him and handle the evil sect before challenging the dungeon."
Kent nodded.
They have only 12 years to clear all 37 floors of the dungeon. So far, they’ve only cleared 4, and from the look of things, the next six floors will be as dangerous as they can be.
However, with Uncle Drew back, the chances of them going even further than 10 floors are rather high. Uncle Drew is at the Death stage, and so are over 6 of his 14 Night Agents.
This means, regardless of the danger they find themselves in, they wouldn’t have to worry much about anything.
Of course, they also run the risk of meeting immortals since the dungeon is akin to a unique world. This means there might even be gods inside.

So taking cautious steps is the most important thing they can do. Of course, Kent would be more than happy to clear the dungeon since once it had been cleared, the floor boss would become his to command.
This means if the final floor boss is a god, he will have a god under his command. This also means he has more to gain than to lose.
"Just make sure to summon me whenever you face a danger you can’t handle."
Kaizo nodded.
Kent had already reached the Spirit Lord stage, so facing even a Death stage cultivator isn’t going to be a problem.

But since he knew anything was possible, he decided to include himself less and focus on his main mission. This way, he legion will grow much stronger than and be able to prove their worth like they wanted to.
After the conversation, Kent joined the legion to attack the first three outposts of the evil sect. Once he made sure his legion could handle the mission, he left it in Kaizo’s capable hands.
His next destination is Planet Tianxu, which is Liora’s homeworld.
It is a planet for humans, Spirit Beasts, and Sky Foxes. Liora, of course, is a human; however, she is also part Sky Fox from her mother’s side.
Kent couldn’t wait long enough to meet his in-laws since, according to Liora, her family on both her father and mother side is still alive, the last time she saw them.
Of course, from the way she spoke, one could tell she hated her father and that side of her family. However, her mother died when she was young, so she had no choice but to live with her father.
Kent is looking forward to meeting them regardless.
Most of his wives are orphans, so meeting his in-laws, in a way, sounds like a wonderful experience to him.
So once he was done putting all ten Pill Worlds under his command by adding them to his Guardian Tower, they left.
He couldn’t add them to his guardian tower when he first came to the Pill Worlds, but now, he will know when they are in danger and do his best to handle it before things escalate.
It will take them five weeks to get to Planet Tianxu, so they have more than enough time to spend together.
Kent plans to use the five weeks to attend to the needs of his wives, especially the new ones he added recently.
So once they entered the ship and left the Pill World, he and Liora entered the tower, where they would have more than enough time to themselves.
Liora also wants to fully become one with Kent, as the rest of his wives have.
Selene, who decided to enjoy the ride, summoned Unity and Alina to ride with her while their man attended to their new sisters.

Kent had met one of the Six True Primordials and saw just how vast the distance between them is. There was no comparison between them.

He had already remembered his memories of his life as Chaos to the point when he reached the True Immortal stage. However, from what he had seen, he was nowhere close to someone like Bhaalzhar, the Slaughter King.
The gap is vast.
Of course, he wondered why he was that weak despite Bhaalzhar saying he is the 7th True Primordial. He even said Kent is meant to be the strongest of them.
So if he was the 7th, the best of them, how then is he this weak?
Naturally, now that he had awakened 25% of his bloodline, he seemed to have realised why.
His bloodline, the true Chaos Dragon bloodline, is now awakening. The true him is now awakening. He had just taken the first step.
What he had been depending on was just the tip of the iceberg.
His true strength, the strength a true Primordial should have, Kent finally saw what he had to do to claim it. Now, he had claimed one, but there are dozens still left to claim.
The Slaughter King already told him to become the real him; he must find all they had left him and make them his. This means this is not even anything he should be proud of just yet.
Before this moment, he was a human with a dragon bloodline. He wasn’t an actual dragon. However, now, it seems he has reached the rank of an actual dragon.
In his human form, he was much weaker. His true strength only comes when he takes on his demi-dragon form.
Not anymore.
His appearance now is that of a dragon. His human form had been transformed into an actual dragon.

Of course, he can take away his wings, horns, and tail, making him appear human. But unlike before, where his strength weakens in his human form, this time around, whether he had dragon horns or not, his strength would not change.
That form was just a temporal vessel he used to cultivate his bloodline.
His appearance now gave him that imposing man form, the kind that the Chaos Dragon is known to have. Chaos could intimidate anyone with just his presence.
However, Kent had become something else now. He is now walking toward the realm of a True Primordial, something Chaos never had the chance to.

"It is both metallic and bone. Which is which?"

The only ones who aren’t there are Vexthra, who has gone to the God Realm, Runa, and Adina. It turned out they can’t even give their man a blowjob, else they risk tainting their body.

They first have to become Immortals to awaken the [Extreme Pure Yin Body Constitution]. It is only then that they can be with their man.

So, in order not to be tempted, Runa and Adina decided to go and start preparing for their True Name awakening. Then, once that was done, they would enter the Primordial Chamber and awaken their Primordial Spirits.
Hopefully, by the time they come out, Kent will have finished his business in the high world and be ready to ascend.
It is heartbreaking. However, for their own good, abstaining from sex or anything sexual is what is good for them now. It is for their own good.
However, the rest are more than happy to spend the past 3 months with their man. Kent’s dragon form had won their hearts yet again, renewing their love for him.

He had, of course, accumulated more than enough Limit Breaker Points from just the sex alone. So at the moment, all he needed to do was raise his Soul Cultivation to the Heavenly Ascension stage (Tier 19) and use the Limit Breaker Points to break more limits on his body.
Of course, once he becomes an Immortal, his dual cultivation will come into play yet again. Those Immortal Qi aren’t going to form themselves after all.
Also, his cultivation has already reached the Level 7 Spirit Lord stage. It turned out that raising his bloodline awakening percentage affected his cultivation.
But with his bloodline now at 25%, fighting Root Immortals is not impossible.
However, it wasn’t just him who had benefited. All his wives are now at the peak of the Spirit Lord stage. The only thing stopping them now is him.

Once he returns to his mission, they will enter seclusion and break through to the Heavenly Ascension stage. This also means that even if Uncle Drew is not around, they can handle Life-stage and perhaps Death-stage warriors.
For Immortals, they are not quite there yet.
"So are you leaving?" Unity asked...
"No, I plan on spending some time with Runa and Adina. After that, I will awaken the True Name for the two of them, Enzi, Liora, Arien, and Indie, before leaving."

This time around, Kent ran off to Nature City, where Runa and Adina are spending their boring lives.
Meanwhile, Uncle Drew had finally returned to the underworld.

chapters.title: Chapter 1197: Back to the Underworld
paragraphs: In the 9th level of the underworld, everybody knew who Uncle Drew was.
When he first came there, many tried to get to him and use him to escape the underworld. After all, he is a living being who somehow managed to get to the underworld with his living body.
If they can find out how he managed that, perhaps they can escape.
However, they soon learn that reaching Uncle Drew was next to impossible. It turned out he is a special guest of their Queen, and, as such, unless they want to die, getting to him is impossible.
So in the 9th level of the underworld, Uncle Drew is like a king.
However, he doesn’t care about that at all. His focus was more on growing stronger so he could protect his young master much better.

He had accomplished most of it, but just when he thought he could escape back to the land of the living, where he would laze around some more, he was sent back to the underworld, this time with a mission that would take him down to hell.
It seems now that he has finally become strong, things aren’t going as simply as he thought. Then again, he had no idea what destiny had in store for him on this mission.
"You know, when you said you wouldn’t be coming back here for at least another thousand years, I expected you actually to keep that promise. Now, here you are again."
Nyx, seated on her dark throne, said, taking a sip of hell wine, a special brew her friend Bilad sent her from the 6th level of Hell.

Seven Underworld Lords were seated in what appeared to be a meeting. They turn and look at Uncle Drew. Some of them even smile since Uncle Drew bragged to them that he would be gone for several centuries.
Uncle Drew didn’t say anything and just walked to a seat specially prepared for him. He closed his eyes and started waiting for them to finish their meeting.
The Underworld Lords didn’t mind. They are already used to Uncle Drew being around since he is a special guest to their queen.
A day in the land of the living is ten days in the underworld. Uncle Drew had been gone for almost two years, so that was quite some time he spent with them there.
Some trained with him, while others merely exchanged greetings in passing.
After an hour, the meeting ended, and they left.
"Well, what brought you back, Lord Kael?" Nyx teased, but Uncle Drew ignored her.
He opened his eyes from his partial sleep and spoke in a lazy tone... "Young Master said hi."
Hearing what Uncle Drew said, Nyx’s expression brightened. "How is he doing?"
"He is more than fine."
"I see." Nyx became sad again.
She misses Kent a lot, but she can’t leave, not just yet, so all she could do was miss him and wait for him to come to her.
"I suppose he is why you are here."
"Obviously. I wouldn’t leave the land of the living just to come hang around with dead people."
Nyx smirked... "See who is talking. Makes me wonder what you are again. Oh, a night rider, someone stuck between life and death."
Uncle Drew smiled.
He is indeed stuck between the two; however, that doesn’t mean staying in the land of the dead is ideal. Naturally, staying with the living is much more enjoyable.
He has Gaia and her band of troublemakers to worry him every single day.
So he would love to live among the living rather than with the dead.
"My young master sent me to Hell. He said you can help me get there, and since it is urgent, I would love to be on my way soon."
"Did something bad happen?"
"Kinda. The young master wants to wage war on the immortal family that kidnapped his friend and locked him away. You know, the bird guy."
"Oh, I see. Bilad will be happy to send some hell demons to aid him."
Nyx waved her hand, and the space around them shifted. One second, they were in the meeting hall; the next second, they were standing before a door.
"This gate leads you to Hell. However, unlike here, where you can roam freely, Hell is different, so be careful. Bilad will know you are coming."

Uncle Drew looked at Nyx with a straight expression. Seeing this, Nyx smiled... "Sorry, I forgot you are the master of the infamous 14th level of Hell. Not that I believe it exists, but whatever makes you happy, I guess."
Uncle Drew didn’t say anything and just opened the door. "Prepare a gift for the Young Master by the time I return. I have found a way to transport items to the land of the living now."
"Oh, really. I’d better get on that fast."
Uncle Drew didn’t say anything and just left. The moment he walked through the open door, it closed behind him.
[6th Level of Hell - Nex Morbus]
A lot had changed since Kent left Hell over three million years ago. All 14 cities are now fortresses. The walls are tall and armed with all kinds of formations and arrays.

After Kent left, Bilad decided to create one of the strongest hell levels. He was merely an immortal back then; however, he had big dreams to build something big and better, something that could rival even the first level of Hell.
So he started, and after over 3 million years, he had succeeded.
Now, every last City Lord is a demigod with many immortal subordinates. In fact, the first four strongest City Lords have demigods as their subordinates, too.
This projected the 6th level of Hell to a much higher, more powerful level.
Even the overlord of hell lives there now.
Bilad’s dream was realised, and so, after that, he started building a special army, the kind that, when unleashed, no army will stand in their way.
At the moment, he was locked in combat with two demigods. He had long reached the rank of a demigod, and judging by how he was thrashing these demigods, it is clear he is no ordinary demigod.
Suddenly, something vibrated inside his space ring, so he had to pause and answer it.
"Nyx, great of you to finally remember I am still alive."
"Don’t overestimate yourself, Bilad. I wouldn’t be calling to check up on you... I have more important things to focus on."
Bilad smiled and asked, "Then why did you call?"

"Your boss sent someone to deliver a message to you. Naturally, I wouldn’t say anything, but knowing you want to impress him, maybe impressing his subordinate will suffice. Just don’t pair him against anyone above the True Immortal stage."
"He is that monstrous, huh?"
"Well, he entered the Inner Region of the Black Castle while he was at the Heavenly Ascension stage."
Bilad furrowed his brow, "Interesting. Thanks for the info, Nyx."
"Whatever."
Nyx hung up, and Bilad turned to the hell demons assembled in the arena with him. "I need five True Immortals to challenge someone who is currently on his way here."

sentences.text: In the 9th level of the underworld, everybody knew who Uncle Drew was.
When he first came there, many tried to get to him and use him to escape the underworld.
After all, he is a living being who somehow managed to get to the underworld with his living body.
If they can find out how he managed that, perhaps they can escape.
However, they soon learn that reaching Uncle Drew was next to impossible.
It turned out he is a special guest of their Queen, and, as such, unless they want to die, getting to him is impossible.
So in the 9th level of the underworld, Uncle Drew is like a king.
However, he doesn’t care about that at all.
His focus was more on growing stronger so he could protect his young master much better.

He had accomplished most of it, but just when he thought he could escape back to the land of the living, where he would laze around some more, he was sent back to the underworld, this time with a mission that would take him down to hell.
It seems now that he has finally become strong, things aren’t going as simply as he thought.
Then again, he had no idea what destiny had in store for him on this mission.
"You know, when you said you wouldn’t be coming back here for at least another thousand years, I expected you actually to keep that promise.
Now, here you are again."
Nyx, seated on her dark throne, said, taking a sip of hell wine, a special brew her friend Bilad sent her from the 6th level of Hell.
Seven Underworld Lords were seated in what appeared to be a meeting.
They turn and look at Uncle Drew.
Some of them even smile since Uncle Drew bragged to them that he would be gone for several centuries.
Uncle Drew didn’t say anything and just walked to a seat specially prepared for him.
He closed his eyes and started waiting for them to finish their meeting.
The Underworld Lords didn’t mind.
They are already used to Uncle Drew being around since he is a special guest to their queen.
A day in the land of the living is ten days in the underworld.
Uncle Drew had been gone for almost two years, so that was quite some time he spent with them there.
Some trained with him, while others merely exchanged greetings in passing.
After an hour, the meeting ended, and they left.
"Well, what brought you back, Lord Kael?" Nyx teased, but Uncle Drew ignored her.
He opened his eyes from his partial sleep and spoke in a lazy tone...
"Young Master said hi."
Hearing what Uncle Drew said, Nyx’s expression brightened.
"How is he doing?"
"He is more than fine."
"I see." Nyx became sad again.
She misses Kent a lot, but she can’t leave, not just yet, so all she could do was miss him and wait for him to come to her.
"I suppose he is why you are here."
"Obviously.
I wouldn’t leave the land of the living just to come hang around with dead people."
Nyx smirked...
"See who is talking.
Makes me wonder what you are again.
Oh, a night rider, someone stuck between life and death."
Uncle Drew smiled.
He is indeed stuck between the two; however, that doesn’t mean staying in the land of the dead is ideal.
Naturally, staying with the living is much more enjoyable.
He has Gaia and her band of troublemakers to worry him every single day.
So he would love to live among the living rather than with the dead.
"My young master sent me to Hell.
He said you can help me get there, and since it is urgent, I would love to be on my way soon."
"Did something bad happen?"
"Kinda.
The young master wants to wage war on the immortal family that kidnapped his friend and locked him away.
You know, the bird guy."
"Oh, I see.
Bilad will be happy to send some hell demons to aid him."
Nyx waved her hand, and the space around them shifted.
One second, they were in the meeting hall; the next second, they were standing before a door.
"This gate leads you to Hell.
However, unlike here, where you can roam freely, Hell is different, so be careful.
Bilad will know you are coming."
Uncle Drew looked at Nyx with a straight expression.
Seeing this, Nyx smiled...
"Sorry, I forgot you are the master of the infamous 14th level of Hell.
Not that I believe it exists, but whatever makes you happy, I guess."
Uncle Drew didn’t say anything and just opened the door.
"Prepare a gift for the Young Master by the time I return.
I have found a way to transport items to the land of the living now."
"Oh, really.
I’d better get on that fast."
Uncle Drew didn’t say anything and just left.
The moment he walked through the open door, it closed behind him.
[6th Level of Hell - Nex Morbus]
A lot had changed since Kent left Hell over three million years ago.
All 14 cities are now fortresses.
The walls are tall and armed with all kinds of formations and arrays.
After Kent left, Bilad decided to create one of the strongest hell levels.
He was merely an immortal back then; however, he had big dreams to build something big and better, something that could rival even the first level of Hell.
So he started, and after over 3 million years, he had succeeded.
Now, every last City Lord is a demigod with many immortal subordinates.
In fact, the first four strongest City Lords have demigods as their subordinates, too.
This projected the 6th level of Hell to a much higher, more powerful level.
Even the overlord of hell lives there now.
Bilad’s dream was realised, and so, after that, he started building a special army, the kind that, when unleashed, no army will stand in their way.
At the moment, he was locked in combat with two demigods.
He had long reached the rank of a demigod, and judging by how he was thrashing these demigods, it is clear he is no ordinary demigod.
Suddenly, something vibrated inside his space ring, so he had to pause and answer it.
"Nyx, great of you to finally remember I am still alive."
"Don’t overestimate yourself, Bilad.
I wouldn’t be calling to check up on you...
I have more important things to focus on."
Bilad smiled and asked, "Then why did you call?"
"Your boss sent someone to deliver a message to you.
Naturally, I wouldn’t say anything, but knowing you want to impress him, maybe impressing his subordinate will suffice.
Just don’t pair him against anyone above the True Immortal stage."
"He is that monstrous, huh?"
"Well, he entered the Inner Region of the Black Castle while he was at the Heavenly Ascension stage."
Bilad furrowed his brow, "Interesting.
Thanks for the info, Nyx."
"Whatever."
Nyx hung up, and Bilad turned to the hell demons assembled in the arena with him.
"I need five True Immortals to challenge someone who is currently on his way here."

chapters.title: Chapter 1198: Hell Warriors Vs Uncle Drew
paragraphs: Uncle Drew obviously wasn’t looking forward to a duel with not one but five hell demons just when he arrived in hell. However, just when he arrived on the 6th level of hell, five hell demons stopped him with hostile looks in their eyes.
Of course, it is hell, so no one is cheerful there. But that doesn’t even mean he should be stored with hostile Intent when he hadn’t offended everyone.
Uncle Drew somehow appeared at the entrance of Gorathis, the City of Chains. It is the first city Kent conquered back when he was walking the hell road.
The five hell demons standing at the entrance of the city are all True Immortals.
Four of them have four Immortal Qi despite being True Immortals. Most True Immortals have three. As for the strongest among them, he has five Immortal Qi.
"Stop right there, human."
One of them, a hell demon with metallic skin and flame for eyes, commanded, his voice carrying the pressure of his five Immortal Qis.

Uncle Drew stopped in his tracks, raised his head, and looked at the five hell demons. He had the urge to use Kent’s name to command them to step aside; however, in that very moment, a voice entered his mind.
’If you want to be followed into battle, then show them who you are.’ Nyx’s nonchalant voice entered his head.
Obviously, Uncle Drew’s main reason for coming to hell was to recruit hell demons to help him in rescuing Kaelith from the prison he was put in.
He didn’t specifically tell Nyx what he intended to do in hell. However, it seems she was able to deduce a part of it, and so she prepared the way for him.
’How tiresome.’
"Show some identification," one of the hell demons demanded, his expression hostile, just when Uncle Drew looked at them.
Uncle Drew furrowed his brow and said:

"This is hell, bubby. I may be a living soul, but I know there is no identification in hell, so why don’t we cut to the chase?" Uncle Drew sneered and pointed at the five hell demons blocking his way.
"You are here to challenge me to a duel. Naturally, I don’t mind; however, I have a condition. If you accept, I might not kill any of you."
The expression on the faces of the five hell demons changed.
They didn’t expect the human standing before them to be that bold. In fact, they expected him to plead for his life, considering he is four ranks below them.
Uncle Drew is only at the peak of the Death Stage. He would have to go through the Root, Spirit, and Core Immortal stages before reaching the level they are now.
So for him to threaten them that he might just not kill them if they accept his condition—that came as a shock to them.
"Kill us?... Hahahahahahah!"
They burst into uncontrollable laughter.
It is indeed funny.
Any immortal in their place would be amused, considering the gap between them.
Uncle Drew smiled, watching them laugh. He didn’t speak without a reason.
This is hell.
Uncle Drew can directly command hell flames.
Naturally, that makes him super powerful inside hell; they might be immortals, but inside hell, Uncle Drew is at his peak.

Suddenly, his eyes turned green, and flames burst out of them. His aura instantly changed, causing the air to turn cold despite their location. Then his clothes changed into his hell armor. Cracks filled with green molten lava littered most parts of his armor.
His dual swords were perfectly sheathed behind him, forming into an X.
"Come."
Crack
The space cracked, and green flames poured out. Then, from within the crack, a dark horse, body covered in metallic armor, walked out, bringing with it terrifying energy.
In an instant, Uncle Drew changed from an ordinary human to a battle-ready warrior, one who caused the five immortals to take a few steps back.
He placed his hand on his hellhorse and took a step forward.

"The weather was relatively calm that day. I had just returned from war and learned a demon king had kidnapped my brother, and they planned on selling him to a succubus queen who seemed to have found a liking for my handsome brother.

I was furious, so like always, I took my swords, jumped on my battle horse, and went after him. Friends advised me to relax and make a good plan; however, my brother was everything I had back then, so I listened to no one.
Of course, they were right. The one they wanted was me, so they kidnapped my brother to lure me out. Safe to say it worked. I would jump into molten lava to save my brother."
A mask appeared in Uncle Drew’s hand.
Looking at it, he smiled.
"Immortals surrounded me on all sides. A demigod stood in the air, holding my brother by the neck. Hidden expects hid, ready to take action and end me.
’Drop to your knee and submit to me, and I will let your brother go. The demigod commanded"
Uncle Drew smirked, "Those words were the last words she spoke because by sunset, 12,000 immortals and a demigod fell to my swords."
The mask in his hand flew on its own and covered his face... "I was just a True Immortal back then."
With that, he moved, and his hell horse also moved.
Sitting somewhere in the city, a man opened his eyes, and the aura of death oozed out from them. He looked toward the city entrance and smiled.
Uncle Drew and his hell horse had clashed with the five immortals, and every banished soul in the city felt the battle.

Most rushed to the city gate, some stood on the walls, and most clung to the many chains hanging in the city. They all wanted to watch the legendary battle, one that they would compare to the Hell Road challenge 3 million years ago.
Two hours later, the five Immortals were on the ground, sweat falling down their bodies. Every last one of them was tired, injured, and barely holding on to their consciousness.
Jaws hung low by the time the battle came to an end. It doesn’t make sense one bit.
The leader of the five hell demons looked at Uncle Drew, now seated on his hell horse, and asked in a shaky tone,
"W-who...are...y-you?"
"He is a being of legend."
Suddenly, the person hidden in the city appeared not far from Uncle Drew and spoke.
Everyone turned their focus to the new arrival, many recognizing him as the Overlord of Hell.
One could see the look of respect in his eyes despite his status as the Overlord of Hell.
He turned to everyone, and in a tone that spread to all 14 cities, he said,
"There are 69 of them. They ride through the night, cutting down all kinds of horror. When they move, they move with the night, and when they fight, they fight with the night.
They go by many names, but they respond to the Night Rider name. Everyone, pay your respect to Kael Duskbane, the legendary Captain of the Night Riders."
Like being compelled by an external force, all hell demons went on their knees and bowed toward Uncle Drew.
"Welcome to Hell, Kael Duskbane..."
Uncle Drew removed his mask and turned toward the Overlord of Hell.
A small, proud smile appeared on his face.
"How have you been, Laziel?"
"I’ve been well, Captain. I just miss you a lot... all of us did."
Just when he said that, cracks appeared in the air, and seven people riding hell horses appeared.
"Welcome to Hell, Captain... we have been awaiting your arrival."

chapters.title: Chapter 1199: Night Riders Reunion
paragraphs: Before the Wraith Queen died, she blessed 69 people with the power of the night. These 69 later became the elite known as the Night Riders.
To date, they are known as the most lethal and most dangerous warrior unit in the universe. No unit came close, not even the legendary Undead Legion or the Eternal Wrath legion
Their leader, Kael Duskbane, had led them into many battles, their last being the battle against the creatures of the dark. In that battle, they fought side by side with many other great warriors.
It was a harrowing battle, one that ended all battles in the Dark Era.
However, nobody knew how they fell.

Many speculated that their end came at the hands of a betrayer they trusted. Some say they entered the Dark Realm and sealed it from within, thereby preventing future confrontations with its creatures.
There are many speculations and rumours about how they died.
However, one thing was sure...
One day, the Night Riders would return.
Many knew that - both allies and enemies.
They knew they would return, and now, watching the seven people jump down from their hellhorses, each exuding the power of a Demigod, Uncle Drew could only smile.
He felt both pride and respect for them. After all, every last one of them followed him into battle during the Dark Era.
"It is good to see you guys again," he said as he walked toward them with a smile on his face. They embraced in one big Night Riders hug, the kind that shows just how much they miss each other.
"How have you been, Captain?" a brute holding an axe asked.
The smile on his face shows he is happy. And well, despite their captain only being at the Death stage, all eight of them, which include Laziel, look at him with respect.
Laziel is even a god, yet he is respectful toward Uncle Drew.
"I have been well, Vargus," Uncle Drew said with a smile.
He then turned and looked at the millions of people watching from the city. "Maybe we should take this somewhere else."
Laziel nodded and snapped his finger. The next second, they are standing atop a tall mountain, looking over a majestic city in the distance.
He then proceeded to shield them from outside interference. Once he made sure nobody could spy on them, he nodded to the rest of them.
"I believe it is no coincidence you all are here now. After all, we both know what is coming and what preparations are coming.
However, I will still ask, What are you doing here?" Uncle Drew asked, directing his question to Laziel since he is the strongest of them at the moment.
He smiled and answered, "First of all, I believe we both remember what happened in the last minutes of the battle against the Creatures of the Dark."
Uncle Drew and the seven other Night Riders nodded, their expressions turning dark.
"Well, when I regained my memories after my rebirth, I started looking for the rest; however, even after a million years searching, I couldn’t get wind of anyone.

Depressed, I came down to hell and decided to become a Hell King. They would have given me a purpose for a while. However, in the process of becoming a Hell King, the Overlord of Hell found out my identity, and so he tried to kill me.
Let’s just say he failed, and thanks to him, I easily became a god and the supreme Overlord of all 13 levels of hell. I have been living here since.
However, about 40,000 years ago, Vargus found me, and thanks to him, I managed to track down the others. Now, as you can see, there are eight of us here so far.
However, we learned that the others have returned to the Dark City since the veil is thinning.
Of course, not all of them are there, so we will have to look for the rest. However, to reunite with you, we had to wait for you to come here before heading to the Dark City."
Uncle Drew raised his brow... "So you knew I would be coming."
"Of course, the Weeping Virgin told me."
Uncle Drew chuckled. "That woman is still alive, huh. I guess old bones die hard."
The Weeping Virgin is an old legend.
She is a woman with many mysteries. According to legend, she lived during the Primordial Era, and since then, she had appeared at least once in every Era, always bringing fatal news.
"The last time we met, she predicted the master would be betrayed, and true to her words, he was indeed betrayed, leading to us all dying."
Uncle Drew smiled, "I wanted her dead, you know, but it seems she had her role to play after all."
Laziel and the others nodded. "That she did. She predicted you would come here and that when you arrive, I should announce to all of hell that the Night Riders are back.
I wanted to ask some questions, but you know her already."
Uncle Drew smirked and decided to forget about the Weeping Virgin and focus on the fact that he had reunited with his team, or a part of them.
"Young Master has reincarnated, too. He was the one who sent me here."
"Really? How does he look? Is he still the same old Bandit?"
"Is he tall, strong, and mighty?"
"Can he solo us in combat?"

All kinds of questions were asked by the Night Riders, leaving Uncle Drew to wonder just what to say. Kent isn’t exactly strong at the moment. He is only at the Spirit Lord stage, so asking if he can solo a Demigod is just asking too much.
Of course, he knew they were asking these questions simply because they missed him.

To the rest of the universe, there were only 69 Night Riders. However, there was a 70th. Of course, he wasn’t a Night Rider, but he was a creature of the night, a being so ruthless his name has been wiped from the history books.
Hearing he is back, they all want to know more about him and, if possible, exchange blows to see if he is still the old him.
In the end, however, Uncle Drew had the perfect answer.
"How many of you knew the Chaos Dragon that lived and ruled the Primordial Era?"
They all raised their hands.
Uncle Drew smiled and said:
"You see, he is the Master’s true self. In other words, Master was the Primordial Chaos Dragon."
"WHAT"
"Don’t be shocked. He was also the greatest swordsman to have ever lived. Aside from that, he was also known as the Faceless Assassin."
"Are you saying the Red Scythe Ruthless Bandit, the man who painted battlefield red and caused every god to go into hiding, was the Primordial Chaos Dragon the whole time?"
"A part of his soul from what the master told me. But yes."
"Damn," Laziel took a deep breath, his mind reeling from what he had just heard. "Who knew our ruthless master was actually that cool in his past life?"
Uncle Drew smiled and said, "Oh, he is cooler in this life. You see, he is also the King of the 6th level of hell."
"Wait a minute." Laziel raised his slender finger to pause Uncle Drew... "Are you saying our master, the Ruthless Bandit, is Kent Madson..."
This time, the seven Night Riders beside him raised their brows.
